H0428.d: אֵ֫לֶּה pr.pl.m. & f. these; in appos. to a subst. with a pron. suff. (always without the article); repeated, אלה … ואלה, these … those; with the art. (but only after a subst. determined likewise by the art.); with preps
H0428.sd: these or those — an-(the) other; one sort, so, some, such, them, these (same), they, this, those, thus, which, who(-m)
H0428.kd: אֵ֫לֶּה — 지시대명사 복수, 남녀 공용. '이것들, 이 사람들'. 접미사가 붙은 명사에 동격으로 놓일 때는 늘 관사 없이 씁니다. 되풀이해 짝을 이루면 '이들은 ~ 저들은 ~'이 됩니다. 관사가 붙는 것은 앞의 명사도 관사로 한정되었을 때뿐입니다. 전치사와 함께 여러 관용구를 이룹니다.

H8034.d: שֵׁם 864 n.m. name (√ unknown); of river, beasts, city, i.e. exact designation of it; usu. of pers; = reputation; esp. as giving a man a kind of posthumous life, esp. in his sons; name, as designation of God; of false gods, use forbidden; = memorial, monument
H8034.sd: an appellation, as a mark or memorial of individuality; by implication honor, authority, character — base, (in-) fame(-ous), named(-d), renown, report
H8034.kd: שֵׁם — 남성명사, 약 864회. '이름'. 어원은 알려져 있지 않습니다. 첫째, 강·짐승·성읍 등을 정확히 가리키는 명칭. 둘째, 주로 사람의 이름. 셋째, '명성, 평판'. 특히 아들을 통해 이름이 이어지는 것을 일종의 사후의 생명으로 여겼습니다. 넷째, 하나님을 가리키는 이름으로, 거짓 신들의 이름은 입에 올리는 것조차 금지되었습니다. 다섯째, 기념이나 기념물을 뜻하기도 합니다. 스트롱은 개별성을 나타내는 표지에서 권위와 인격이라는 뜻이 파생했다고 봅니다.

H1121a.d: בֵּן 4870 n.m. son; son, male child, born of a woman; children (male and female); youth, young men; the young of animals; of plant shoots; fig. of lifeless things, sparks, stars, arrows; member of a guild, order or class; of animals son of (the) herd; ב׳ as n. relat. followed by word of quality, characteristic, etc; n. relat. of age
H1121a.sd: a son (as a builder of the family name), in the widest sense (of literal and figurative relationship, including grandson, subject, nation, quality or condition, etc., (like father or brother), etc.) — afflicted, age, (Ahoh-) (Ammon-) (Hachmon-) (Lev-) ite, (anoint-) ed one, appointed to, ( ) arrow, (Assyr-) (Babylon-) (Egypt-) (Grec-) ian, one born, bough, branch, breed, (young) bullock, (young) calf, × came up in, child, colt, × common, × corn, daughter, × of first, firstborn, foal, very fruitful, postage, × in, kid, lamb, ( ) man, meet, mighty, nephew, old, ( ) people, rebel, robber, × servant born, × soldier, son, spark, steward, stranger, × surely, them of, tumultuous one, valiant(-est), whelp, worthy, young (one), youth
H1121a.kd: בֵּן — 남성명사, 약 4,870회. '아들'. 첫째, 여인에게서 난 아들, 남자아이. 둘째, 복수로 남녀를 아우른 '자녀'. 셋째, 젊은이, 청년. 넷째, 짐승의 새끼. 다섯째, 식물의 순. 여섯째, 비유적으로 무생물에도 써서 불꽃, 별, 화살을 가리킵니다. 일곱째, 어떤 조합·계열·집단의 구성원(예: 선지자의 생도). 여덟째, 짐승에 대해 '떼의 아들' 곧 그 무리에서 난 것. 아홉째, 성질이나 특징을 나타내는 말과 함께 쓰여 그 성질을 지닌 자를 뜻하고, 나이를 나타내는 말과 함께 쓰여 '~살 된 자'가 됩니다.

H3478.d: יִשְׂרָאֵל 2507 n.pr.m. et gent. Israel (Ēl persisteth, persevereth); n.pr.m. second name of Jacob; n.pr.gent. name of Hebrew nation
H3478.sd: he will rule as God; Jisraël, a symbolical name of Jacob; also (typically) of his posterity — Israel
H3478.kd: יִשְׂרָאֵל — 고유명사, 약 2,507회. '이스라엘'. 이름의 뜻은 '하나님이 겨루신다·굳게 세우신다'로 풀이합니다. 첫째, 야곱이 얍복 나루에서 받은 두 번째 이름. 둘째, 그 후손으로 이루어진 히브리 민족의 이름. 스트롱은 '그가 하나님으로서 다스리리라'로 풀며, 야곱과 그 후손을 아울러 가리키는 상징적 이름으로 봅니다.

H0935.d: בּוֹא 2569 vb. come in, come, go in, go; Qal; come in; come (approach, arrive); go, i.e. walk, associate with; go from speaker, but with limit of motion given; Hiph; cause to come in, bring in (conduct, lead, obj. persons and animals); cause to come, bring, bring near, etc. (animate obj.); Hoph; be brought in (of pers. and things); be brought; be introduced, put
H0935.sd: to go or come (in a wide variety of applications) — abide, apply, attain, × be, befall, besiege, bring (forth, in, into, to pass), call, carry, × certainly, (cause, let, thing for) to come (against, in, out, upon, to pass), depart, × doubtless again, eat, employ, (cause to) enter (in, into, -tering, -trance, -try), be fallen, fetch, follow, get, give, go (down, in, to war), grant, have, × indeed, (in-) vade, lead, lift (up), mention, pull in, put, resort, run (down), send, set, × (well) stricken (in age), × surely, take (in), way
H0935.kd: בּוֹא — 동사, 약 2,569회. '오다, 들어가다, 가다'. 칼형에서 (1) 들어가다, (2) 오다, 다가오다, 이르다, (3) 가다, 곧 걸어가다·함께 다니다, (4) 말하는 이에게서 떠나가되 이르는 지점이 명시된 경우. 히필형은 '들어오게 하다, 데려오다, 이끌어 들이다'(사람이나 짐승을 목적어로), '가져오다, 가까이 가져오다'. 호팔형은 '들여보내지다, 이끌려 오다, 놓이다'. 해가 '들어가다'는 곧 해가 지는 것을 뜻합니다.

H4714.d: מִצְרַ֫יִם 681 n.pr.terr. et gent. Egypt, Egyptians; of land, Egypt; combinations; of people: in table of nations, personif. as second son of Ham; = Egypt (as a people), Egyptians
H4714.sd: Mitsrajim, i.e. Upper and Lower Egypt — Egypt, Egyptians, Mizraim
H4714.kd: מִצְרַ֫יִם — 땅과 민족을 함께 가리키는 고유명사, 약 681회. 애굽. 첫째, 땅으로서의 애굽. 둘째, 민족으로서의 애굽 사람. 열국의 족보에서는 함의 둘째 아들로 인격화되어 나타납니다. 형태가 쌍수인 것은 상·하 애굽을 아울렀기 때문으로 봅니다.

H0854.d: אֵת, prep. with—prep. denoting proximity; Of companionship, together with; Of localities; אֵת פּ׳ denotes specially; in one's possession or keeping; in one's knowledge or memory; מֵאֵת from proximity with Note. אֵת expresses closer association than עִם: hence while מֵעִם sts. denotes hardly more than from the surroundings or belongings of, מֵאֵת expresses from close proximity to
H0854.sd: properly, nearness (used only as a preposition or an adverb), near; hence, generally, with, by, at, among, etc — against, among, before, by, for, from, in(-to), (out) of, with. Often with another prepositional prefix
H0854.kd: אֵת — 전치사. 가까이 있음을 나타냅니다. 첫째, 동행하여 '~와 함께'. 둘째, 장소를 나타내어 '~곁에'. 사람과 함께 쓰이면 '~의 소유로, ~가 간직하여', '~가 알거나 기억하는 바로'가 됩니다. 합성형 מֵאֵת는 '~에게서'. 같은 뜻의 עִם과 견주면 אֵת가 더 가까운 관계를 나타내어, מֵעִם은 '~의 주변에서'에 가까운 반면 מֵאֵת는 '바로 그 곁에서'를 뜻합니다. 목적격 표지 אֵת(H0853)와 형태가 같으므로 문맥으로 가려야 합니다.

H3290.d: יַעֲקֹב 344, יַעֲקוֹב 6 n.pr.m. et gent. Jacob, son of Isaac and Rebekah, father of tribes of Isr; as n.pr.m; as n.pr.gent
H3290.kd: יַעֲקֹב — 남성 고유명사이자 민족 이름, 약 350회. 야곱. 이삭과 리브가의 아들이며 이스라엘 열두 지파의 조상입니다. 사람 이름으로도, 그에게서 난 백성 전체를 가리키는 이름으로도 쓰여 시문에서 '이스라엘'과 짝을 이룹니다.

H0376.sd: a man as an individual or a male person; often used as an adjunct to a more definite term (and in such cases frequently not expressed in translation) — also, another, any (man), a certain, champion, consent, each, every (one), fellow, (foot-, husband-) man, (good-, great, mighty) man, he, high (degree), him (that is), husband, man(-kind), none, one, people, person, steward, what (man) soever, whoso(-ever), worthy. Compare 802
H0376.kd: אִישׁ — 남성명사, 약 2,166회. '사람, 남자'(라틴어 vir에 해당). 여자를 뜻하는 אִשָּׁה와 짝을 이루어 '남편'을 뜻하기도 합니다. 스트롱은 한 개인 또는 남성을 가리키는 말로, 더 구체적인 말에 덧붙어 쓰이는 일이 잦아 번역에 드러나지 않는 경우도 많다고 설명합니다. '각 사람, 어떤 이, 아무도, 사람마다'처럼 부정대명사에 가깝게 쓰이기도 합니다.

H1004b.d: בַּ֫יִת 2034 n.m. house; house; place; receptacle; of house as containing a family; household, family (592 t.); house, including household affairs; lit. housewards, hence metaph. inwards; מִבַּיִת; adv. on the inside; prep. within
H1004b.sd: a house (in the greatest variation of applications, especially family, etc.) — court, daughter, door, + dungeon, family, + forth of, × great as would contain, hangings, home(born), (winter) house(-hold), inside(-ward), palace, place, + prison, + steward, + tablet, temple, web, + within(-out)
H1004b.kd: בַּ֫יִת — 남성명사, 약 2,034회. '집'. 첫째, 건물로서의 집. 둘째, 자리, 장소. 셋째, 무엇을 담는 그릇·통. 넷째, 한 가족을 담는 곳이라는 데서 '집안, 가문'(약 592회). 다섯째, 집안 살림까지 아우르는 '가정'. 여섯째, 문자적으로는 '집 쪽으로'인데 비유적으로 '안쪽으로'. מִבַּיִת는 부사로 '안쪽에', 전치사로 '~안에'. 성전을 '여호와의 집'이라 부르는 용법이 특히 중요합니다.

H7205.d: רְאוּבֵן 71 n.pr.m. Reuben; eldest son of Jacob and Leah; as name of clan or tribe
H7205.sd: Reuben, a son of Jacob — Reuben

H8095.d: שִׁמְעוֹן 44 n.pr.m; second son of Jacob and Leah; tribal name; post-ex. Jew with foreign wife
H8095.sd: Shimon, one of Jacob's sons, also the tribe descended from him — Simeon

H3878.sd: Levi, a son of Jacob — Levi. See also 3879, 3881

H3063.d: יְהוּדָה 820 n.pr.m. et terr. Judah; n.pr.m; son of Jacob and Leah; tribe descended from Judah; nation, of southern kingdom under dynasty of David, as distinguished from northern kingdom of Ephraim or Israel; Levite, Ezra’s time; an overseer of Jerus; Levite musician; priest; n.pr.terr. land of Judah
H3063.sd: Jehudah (or Judah), the name of five Israelites; also of the tribe descended from the first, and of its territory — Judah
H3063.kd: יְהוּדָה — 고유명사, 약 820회. 유다. 첫째, 사람 이름으로 (1) 야곱과 레아 사이에서 난 아들, (2) 에스라 시대의 레위인, (3) 예루살렘의 한 감독, (4) 레위인 악사, (5) 제사장. 둘째, 그 아들에게서 난 지파. 셋째, 다윗 왕조 아래 있던 남쪽 왕국으로, 북쪽의 에브라임 곧 이스라엘과 구별됩니다. 넷째, 땅 이름으로 '유다 땅'.

H3485.sd: Jissaskar, a son of Jacob — Issachar

H2074.d: זְבוּלֻן, זְלֻבוּן n.pr.m. Zebulun; sixth son of Jacob and Leah; the tribe of Zebulun; territory of the tribe
H2074.sd: Zebulon, a son of Jacob; also his territory and tribe — Zebulun

H1144.d: בִּנְיָמִין n.pr.m. 166 (son of (the) right hand)—; youngest son of Jacob, so called by him, but Rachel, the mother, who died at Benjamin's birth, called בֶּן־אוֹנִ֑י (q.v.); son of Bilhan and great-grandson of Benjamin; a Jew of Ezra's time
H1144.sd: Binjamin, youngest son of Jacob; also the tribe descended from him, and its territory — Benjamin

H1835.d: דָּן n.pr.m. (judge); son of Jacob and Bilhah; the tribe of Dan; a city on northern frontier of Israel at one of the sources of the Jordan
H1835.sd: Dan, one of the sons of Jacob; also the tribe descended from him, and its territory; likewise a place in Palestine colonized by them — Daniel

H5321.sd: Naphtali, a son of Jacob, with the tribe descended from him, and its territory — Naphtali

H1410.d: גָּד 71 n.pr.m. (fortunatus?); son of Jacob and Zilpah; a prophet in David's time
H1410.sd: Gad, a son of Jacob, including his tribe and its territory; also a prophet — Gad

H0836.d: אָשֵׁר n.pr.m. Asher (happy one, Felix); son of Jacob and Zilpah; the tribe; n.pr.loc. city E. of Shechem
H0836.sd: Asher, a son of Jacob, and the tribe descended from him, with its territory; also a place in Palestine — Asher

H1961.d: הָיָה 3570 vb. fall out, come to pass, become, be; Qal; Fall out, happen; occur, take place, come about, come to pass; esp. & very oft., come about, come to pass; וַיְהִי and it came to pass that, most often (c. 292 t.); rarely also Pf. c. וְ conj. וְהָיָה; less oft. וְהָיָה Pf. consec. and it shall come to pass, or frequentat. came to pass (repeatedly, etc.); Come into being, become; abs., in lively narrative, arise, appear, come; sq. prep; become; sq. pred. noun (to be viewed as implicit accus.); sq. pred. adj; become like; sq. pred. לְ pers; sq. לְ pred; oft. c. לְ pred. לְ pers; with עַל and לְ; sts. c. לְ pers. only = became the property of, come into the possession of; Be (often with subbordinate idea of becoming); exist, be in existence; abide, remain, continue; with word of locality, be in or at a place, be situated, stand, lie; as copula, joining subj. & pred; periphrastic conjug; Niph; either be done, be brought about, or occur, come to pass; be done, finished, gone
H1961.sd: to exist, i.e. be or become, come to pass (always emphatic, and not a mere copula or auxiliary) — beacon, × altogether, be(-come), accomplished, committed, like), break, cause, come (to pass), do, faint, fall, follow, happen, × have, last, pertain, quit (one-) self, require, × use
H1961.kd: הָיָה — 동사, 약 3,570회. '일어나다, 되다, 있다'. 칼형에서 (1) 일이 일어나다, 생기다, 발생하다. 특히 וַיְהִי '그리고 ~한 일이 있었다'라는 서술 형식으로 약 292회 쓰여 이야기를 여는 표지가 됩니다. וְהָיָה는 '그리고 ~하게 될 것이다' 또는 반복되는 일을 나타냅니다. (2) 생겨나다, ~이 되다. 서술어로 명사·형용사가 오거나 לְ가 붙어 '~이 되다, ~에게 속하게 되다'를 뜻합니다. (3) 있다, 존재하다, 머무르다, 계속되다. 장소를 나타내는 말과 함께 '~에 있다'가 되고, 계사(繫辭)로서 주어와 술어를 잇습니다. 니팔형은 '행해지다, 이루어지다, 끝나다'.

H3605.d: כֹּל once כּוֹל n.m. the whole, all; with foll. gen. (as usually) the whole of, to be rendered, however, often in our idiom, to avoid stiffness, any or every; Absolutely: without the art., all things, all; with the art. הַכֹּל; where the sense is limited by the context to things (or persons) just mentioned; in a wider sense, all, whether of all mankind or of all living things, the universe, or of all the circumstances of life (chiefly late)
H3605.sd: properly, the whole; hence, all, any or every (in the singular only, but often in a plural sense) — (in) all (manner, (ye)), altogether, any (manner), enough, every (one, place, thing), howsoever, as many as, (no-) thing, ought, whatsoever, (the) whole, whoso(-ever)
H3605.kd: כֹּל — 남성명사. '전체, 모두'. 첫째, 뒤에 소유격이 이어지는 일반적인 용법에서 '~의 전체'를 뜻하는데, 우리말로는 굳이 '전체'라 하지 않고 '모든' 또는 '어떤 ~라도'로 옮기는 편이 자연스럽습니다. 둘째, 홀로 쓰일 때는 관사 없이 '모든 것, 만물'을, 정관사가 붙은 הַכֹּל은 앞에서 언급한 것들 전체를 가리킵니다. 셋째, 더 넓게는 온 인류, 모든 생물, 온 우주, 또는 삶의 모든 정황을 뜻하며 이 용법은 주로 후기 문헌에 나타납니다.

H5315.d: נֶ֫פֶשׁ 756 n.f. soul, living being, life, self, person, desire, appetite, emotion, and passion; = that which breathes, the breathing substance or being; The נפשׁ becomes a living being; The נפשׁ is specif; The נפשׁ as the essential of man stands for the man himself; נפשׁ = seat of the appetites, in all periods (46 t.); נ׳ = seat of emotions and passions; נפשׁ is used occasionally for mental acts; נפשׁ for acts of the will is dub; נפשׁ = character is still more dub; נ׳ in D
H5315.sd: properly, a breathing creature, i.e. animal of (abstractly) vitality; used very widely in a literal, accommodated or figurative sense (bodily or mental) — any, appetite, beast, body, breath, creature, × dead(-ly), desire, × (dis-) contented, × fish, ghost, greedy, he, heart(-y), (hath, × jeopardy of) life (× in jeopardy), lust, man, me, mind, mortally, one, own, person, pleasure, (her-, him-, my-, thy-) self, them (your) -selves, slay, soul, tablet, they, thing, (× she) will, × would have it
H5315.kd: נֶ֫פֶשׁ — 여성명사, 약 756회. 하나의 낱말로 '혼, 생명체, 목숨, 자기 자신, 사람, 욕구, 식욕, 감정, 정욕'을 두루 아우릅니다. 본디 '숨쉬는 것' 곧 숨 그 자체이자 숨쉬는 존재를 가리킵니다. 첫째, 네페쉬가 있음으로 살아 있는 존재가 됩니다. 둘째, 사람의 본질을 가리키므로 그 사람 자신을 대신하는 말로 쓰여 '나, 그 사람'이 됩니다. 셋째, 식욕과 욕구가 자리하는 곳으로 46회 쓰입니다. 넷째, 감정과 정욕이 자리하는 곳. 다섯째, 간혹 생각하는 활동에도 쓰입니다. 그리스 철학의 '영혼'과 달리 몸과 따로 떨어진 것이 아니므로, '혼'으로 옮기되 문맥에 따라 '생명, 목숨, 사람, 마음'으로 새겨야 합니다. 짐승에게도 쓰입니다.

H3318.d: יָצָא 1068 vb. go or come out; Qal; go or come out or forth; from (מִן) a place; go forth from (the presence of) a person; in technical senses; of flight, involving escape; depart; of inanimate things; with especial emphasis on idea of origin, source; of children as going forth from loins (of father); go forth to a place; go forward, proceed to or toward something; come or go forth, with esp. ref. to purpose or result; of combinations; Hiph; cause to go or come out, bring out, lead out; fig. obj. persons, bring out of (מִן) distress, etc; bring out animals; inanimate obj; fig. subj. י׳, bring forth from (מִן); Hoph. be brought forth
H3318.sd: to go (causatively, bring) out, in a great variety of applications, literally and figuratively, direct and proxim — × after, appear, × assuredly, bear out, × begotten, break out, bring forth (out, up), carry out, come (abroad, out, thereat, without), be condemned, depart(-ing, -ure), draw forth, in the end, escape, exact, fail, fall (out), fetch forth (out), get away (forth, hence, out), (able to, cause to, let) go abroad (forth, on, out), going out, grow, have forth (out), issue out, lay (lie) out, lead out, pluck out, proceed, pull out, put away, be risen, × scarce, send with commandment, shoot forth, spread, spring out, stand out, × still, × surely, take forth (out), at any time, × to (and fro), utter
H3318.kd: יָצָא — 동사, 약 1,068회. '나가다, 나오다'. 칼형에서 (1) 어떤 장소로부터 나오다, (2) 어떤 사람 앞에서 물러나다, (3) 기술적 용법으로 도피하여 빠져나오다, 떠나다, (4) 무생물이 나오다, (5) 특히 기원·출처를 강조하여 '~에게서 나오다'. 자녀가 아버지의 허리에서 나온다는 표현이 여기 속합니다. (6) 어떤 곳을 향해 나아가다, (7) 목적이나 결과를 염두에 두고 나서다. 히필형은 '나오게 하다, 이끌어 내다, 데리고 나오다'로, 사람을 곤경에서 건져 내는 데도, 짐승이나 물건을 꺼내는 데도 씁니다. 여호와께서 주어일 때는 '~에서 이끌어 내시다'가 됩니다. 호팔형은 '이끌려 나오다'.

H3409.d: יָרֵךְ n.f. thigh, loin, side, base
H3409.sd: the thigh (from its fleshy softness); by euphemistically the generative parts; figuratively, a shank, flank, side — × body, loins, shaft, side, thigh

H3130.d: יוֹסֵף 212 and יְהוֹסֵף n.pr.m. (he adds, increases); elder son of Jacob and Rachael; a man of Issachar; a son of Asaph; one of those who took strange wives; a priest
H3130.sd: Joseph, the name of seven Israelites — Joseph. Compare 3084

H4191.d: מוּת vb. die; Qal; die, of natural or other causes; die as a penalty = be put to death; Po‛lel. kill, put to death, despatch (intens.); Hiph; abs., elsewhere c. acc., subj. man; subj. God, by inflicting penalty; of animals killing men; bring to a premature death; Hoph. be killed, put to death
H4191.sd: to die (literally or figuratively); causatively, to kill — × at all, × crying, (be) dead (body, man, one), (put to, worthy of) death, destroy(-er), (cause to, be like to, must) die, kill, necro(-mancer), × must needs, slay, × surely, × very suddenly, × in (no) wise
H4191.kd: מוּת — 동사, 약 837회. '죽다'. 칼형은 (1) 자연히든 다른 까닭으로든 죽다, (2) 형벌로 죽다 곧 사형당하다. 폴렐형은 강세형으로 '죽이다, 쳐 죽이다'. 히필형은 '죽이다'로, 사람이 주어인 경우와 하나님이 벌을 내려 죽이시는 경우, 짐승이 사람을 죽이는 경우, 때 이르게 죽게 하는 경우가 있습니다. 호팔형은 '죽임을 당하다, 처형되다'.

H0251.d: אָח 630 n.m. brother; brother, born of same mother (& father); indef. = relative; fig. of resemblance; in phr. one … another
H0251.sd: a brother (used in the widest sense of literal relationship and metaphorical affinity or resemblance [like 1]) — another, brother(-ly); kindred, like, other. Compare also the proper names beginning with 'Ah-' or 'Ahi-'
H0251.kd: אָח — 남성명사, 약 630회. '형제'. 첫째, 같은 어머니(와 아버지)에게서 난 형제. 둘째, 넓게는 친족 일반. 셋째, 비유적으로 닮은 것을 두고 '~와 같은 것'. 넷째, 짝을 이루어 '하나는 다른 하나에게' 곧 '서로'라는 뜻을 냅니다. 같은 백성이나 동료를 부르는 말로도 널리 쓰입니다.

H1755.d: דּוֹר, דֹּר n.m. period, generation, dwelling; period, age, generation, mostly poet; of men living at a particular time (period, age), generation, as transitory; generation characterized by quality or condition, class of men; dwelling-place, habitation
H1755.sd: properly, a revolution of time, i.e. an age or generation; also a dwelling — age, × evermore, generation, (n-) ever, posterity

H1931.d: הוּא m. הִיא f., pron. of the 3rd ps. sing. he, she, used also (in both genders) for the neuter it; an emph. he (she, it, they), sometimes equivalent to himself (herself, itself, themselves), or (esp. with the art.) that (those); It resumes the subj. with emph; Where, however, the pron. follows the pred., its position gives it the minimum of emphasis, and it expresses (or resumes) the subject as unobtrusively as possible; It anticipates (as it seems) the subject; As an emph. predicate, of God; In a neuter sense, that, it (of an action, occurrence, matte, etc.); With the art.: so regularly when joined to a subst. defined itself by the art
H1931.sd: he (she or it); only expressed when emphatic or without a verb; also (intensively) self, or (especially with the article) the same; sometimes (as demonstrative) this or that; occasionally (instead of copula) as or are — he, as for her, him(-self), it, the same, she (herself), such, that (...it), these, they, this, those, which (is), who
H1931.kd: הוּא (여성형 הִיא) — 3인칭 단수 인칭대명사. '그, 그것'이며 두 성 모두 중성 '그것'으로도 쓰입니다. 첫째, 강조된 '그·그 자신'. 정관사와 함께 쓰이면 '그(저) ~'라는 지시의 뜻이 됩니다. 둘째, 주어를 다시 받아 강조합니다. 셋째, 술어 뒤에 오면 강조가 가장 약해져 주어를 눈에 띄지 않게 되받습니다. 넷째, 주어를 미리 내세우기도 합니다. 다섯째, 하나님에 대해 강조된 술어로 쓰여 '그분이 (바로) 그이시다'가 됩니다. 여섯째, 중성으로 어떤 행위나 사건을 가리켜 '그것, 그 일'. 일곱째, 계사가 없는 문장에서 '~이다'의 구실을 합니다.

H6509.d: [פָּרָה] vb. bear fruit, be fruitful; Qal; of men and animals; of vine; Hiph; cause to bear fruit; make fruitful; shew fruitfulness, bear fruit
H6509.sd: to bear fruit (literally or figuratively) — bear, bring forth (fruit), (be, cause to be, make) fruitful, grow, increase

H8317.sd: to wriggle, i.e. (by implication) swarm or abound — breed (bring forth, increase) abundantly (in abundance), creep, move

H7235a.d: [רָבָה] 225 vb. be, or become, much, many, great; Qal 59; become many, numerous; be great; grow great (Aramaism); Pi. 4 make large, increase; Hiph. 162; make much or many; make great, obj. pers
H7235a.sd: to increase (in whatever respect) — (bring in) abundance (× -antly), archer (by mistake for 7232), be in authority, bring up, × continue, enlarge, excel, exceeding(-ly), be full of, (be, make) great(-er, -ly, × -ness), grow up, heap, increase, be long, (be, give, have, make, use) many (a time), (any, be, give, give the, have) more (in number), (ask, be, be so, gather, over, take, yield) much (greater, more), (make to) multiply, nourish, plenty(-eous), × process (of time), sore, store, thoroughly, very

H6105a.d: [עָצֹם], עָצַם vb. be vast, mighty, numerous; Qal; be mighty; be numerous; Hiph. make strong
H6105a.sd: to bind fast, i.e. close (the eyes); intransitively, to be (causatively, make) powerful or numerous; to crunch the bones — break the bones, close, be great, be increased, be (wax) mighty(-ier), be more, shut, be(-come, make) strong(-er)

H3966.d: מְאֹד n.m. muchness, force, abundance, exceedingly; force, might; in diff. idioms (298 t.) to express the idea of exceedingly, greatly, very (whether of magnitude or degree)
H3966.sd: properly, vehemence, i.e. (with or without preposition) vehemently; by implication, wholly, speedily, etc. (often with other words as an intensive or superlative; especially when repeated) — diligently, especially, exceeding(-ly), far, fast, good, great(-ly), × louder and louder, might(-ily, -y), (so) much, quickly, (so) sore, utterly, very ( much, sore), well

H4390.d: מָלֵא 249 vb. be full, fill; Qal 99; be full, usu. c. acc. material; trans. fill; Niph; be filled; be accomplished, ended; Pi; fill; special uses are: fulfil, accomplish, complete, obj. week, year, day; Pu. filled; Hithp. mass themselves against me
H4390.sd: to fill or (intransitively) be full of, in a wide application (literally and figuratively) — accomplish, confirm, consecrate, be at an end, be expired, be fenced, fill, fulfil, (be, become, × draw, give in, go) full(-ly, -ly set, tale), (over-) flow, fulness, furnish, gather (selves, together), presume, replenish, satisfy, set, space, take a (hand-) full, have wholly

H0776.d: אֶ֫רֶץ n. f. & (seld.) m. earth, land; earth, whole earth (opp. to a part); earth, opp. to heaven, sky; earth = inhabitants of earth; land =; country, territory; district, region; trial territory; piece of ground; specif. land of Canaan, or Israel; = inhabitants of land; used even of Shᵉʼôl; ground, surface of ground; soil, as productive; אֶרֶץ in phrases; people of the land; in measurements of distance; the country of the plain, level or plain country; land of the living; end(s) of the earth; pl. אֲרָצוֹת is almost wholly late; it denotes lands, countries, often in contrast to Canaan, lands of the nations, etc
H0776.sd: the earth (at large, or partitively a land) — × common, country, earth, field, ground, land, × natins, way, + wilderness, world
H0776.kd: אֶ֫רֶץ — 주로 여성명사, 드물게 남성. '땅'. 첫째, 부분과 대비되는 온 땅, 하늘과 대비되는 땅, 나아가 땅에 사는 이들. 둘째, 나라, 영토, 지역, 지파의 땅, 한 뙈기의 땅. 특히 가나안 땅 곧 이스라엘 땅을 가리키며, 그 땅에 사는 백성을 뜻하기도 합니다. 스올을 가리키는 데까지 쓰입니다. 셋째, 지면, 땅바닥, 소출을 내는 흙. '그 땅의 백성', '평지·들녘', '산 자들의 땅', '땅 끝'과 같은 어구를 이룹니다. 복수형은 거의 후기 문헌에만 나오며 가나안과 대비되는 '열국의 땅들'을 뜻합니다.

H0853.d: אֵת the mark of the accusative, prefixed as a rule only to nouns that are definite
H0853.sd: properly, self (but generally used to point out more definitely the object of a verb or preposition, even or namely) — [as such unrepresented in English]
H0853.kd: אֵת — 목적격 표지. 그 자체로는 뜻을 지니지 않고, 뒤에 오는 말이 동사의 목적어임을 표시합니다. 원칙적으로 한정된(정관사·고유명사·인칭접미사가 붙은) 명사 앞에만 붙습니다. 스트롱은 본래 '자기 자신'을 뜻하던 말이 동사나 전치사의 대상을 더 분명히 가리키는 기능어로 굳어진 것으로 봅니다. 한국어로는 옮길 말이 따로 없고 조사 '을/를'에 해당합니다.

H6965b.d: קוּם 628 vb. arise, stand up, stand; Qal 460; arise; arise, in hostile sense (oft. with idea of suddenness); arise, abs., = become powerful; arise = come on the scene, appear, of leader, prophet; arise for, i.e. to become; arise for action; arise (out of inaction), introducing some specific deed; esp. arise = start, make a move, to go somewhere; stand; Pi; fulfil; confirm, ratify; confirm, establish; impose, an obligation; Pō‛l. raise up; Hithpō‛l. raise oneself, = rise up; Hiph. 146; cause to arise, raise; raise, set up, stones; erect, build; fig, of setting up law; raise up = bring on the scene; raise up = rouse, stir up; instigate, build; fig, of setting up law; raise up = constitute; cause to stand; Hoph. be raised up
H6965b.sd: to rise (in various applications, literal, figurative, intensive and causative) — abide, accomplish, × be clearer, confirm, continue, decree, × be dim, endure, × enemy, enjoin, get up, make good, help, hold, (help to) lift up (again), make, × but newly, ordain, perform, pitch, raise (up), rear (up), remain, (a-) rise (up) (again, against), rouse up, set (up), (e-) stablish, (make to) stand (up), stir up, strengthen, succeed, (as-, make) sure(-ly), (be) up(-hold, -rising)
H6965b.kd: קוּם — 동사, 약 628회. '일어나다, 서다'. 칼형이 460회로, (1) 일어나다, (2) 적대적인 뜻으로 '일어나 대적하다'(흔히 갑작스러움을 함께 나타냅니다), (3) 홀로 쓰여 '강성해지다', (4) 지도자나 선지자가 '나타나다', (5) 무엇이 되기 위해 일어나다, (6) 행동하러 일어서다, (7) 가만히 있다가 어떤 일을 시작하려 일어서다, 특히 어디로 떠나려고 '길을 나서다', (8) 서 있다, 굳게 서다. 피엘형은 '이루다, 확정하다, 세우다, 의무를 지우다'. 폴렐형은 '일으키다'. 히트폴렐형은 '스스로 일어서다'. 히필형은 146회로 '일으키다, 세우다, 짓다, 법을 세우다, 무대에 등장시키다, 부추기다, 세워 삼다, 서게 하다'. 호팔형은 '세워지다'. 언약을 '세우다'라는 표현도 이 말입니다.

H4428.kd: מֶלֶךְ — 남성명사, 약 2,513회. '왕'. 스트롱도 '왕'으로 풀며, 왕에게 속한 것을 가리켜 '왕의, 왕실의'로도 옮깁니다.

H5921a.d: עַל, עָ֑ל; subst. height; As prep. upon, and hence on the ground of, according to, on account of, on behalf of, concerning, beside, in addition to, together with, beyond, above, over, by, on to, towards, to, against; Upon, of the substratum upon which an object in any way rests, or on which an action is performed; —; of clothing, etc., which any one wears; With verbs of covering or protecting, even though the cover or veil be not over or above the thing covered, but around or before it; Of what rests heavily upon a person, or is a burden to him; Of a duty, payment, care, etc., imposed upon a person, or devolving on him; על is used idiom. to give pathos to the expression of an emotion, by emphasizing the person who is its subject, and who, as it were, feels it acting upon him; חָיָה עַל to live upon (as upon a foundation or support); Of the ground or basis, on which a thing is done; It expresses excess; It denotes elevation or pre-eminence; It expresses addition; It expresses the idea of being extended, or suspended over anything, without however being in contact with it, above, over; From the sense of inclining or impending over, על comes to denote contiguity or proximity, Engl. by (or sts. on); In connection with verbs of motion (actual or fig.); By writers of the silver age, על is sts. used with the force of a dative; With other particles: As conj; עַל אֲשֶׁר because that; עַל כִּי similar in meaning, but less frequent; עַל alone: because; notwithstanding that, although; Compounds: with כְּ (rare and late); as concerning, as upon; the like of their deeds is the like of (that which) he will repay; מֵעַל from upon, from over, from by
H5921a.sd: above, over, upon, or against (yet always in this last relation with a downward aspect) in a great variety of applications — above, according to(-ly), after, (as) against, among, and, × as, at, because of, beside (the rest of), between, beyond the time, × both and, by (reason of), × had the charge of, concerning for, in (that), (forth, out) of, (from) (off), (up-) on, over, than, through(-out), to, touching, × with
H5921a.kd: עַל — 본래 '높이'를 뜻하는 명사에서 나온 전치사로, 기본 뜻은 '~위에'입니다. 여기서 매우 넓은 범위로 확장됩니다. 첫째, 무엇이 놓이거나 행해지는 바탕 위. 몸에 걸친 옷, 덮거나 지키는 행위(둘러싸거나 앞을 가리는 경우까지), 사람을 무겁게 누르는 짐, 사람에게 지워진 의무·부담·책임에도 씁니다. 둘째, 감정을 말할 때 그 감정을 느끼는 사람을 부각시켜 표현에 정감을 더합니다. 셋째, 근거·이유(~때문에, ~에 근거하여, ~에 관하여, ~을 위하여). 넷째, 넘어섬·뛰어남·더함(~보다, ~위에, ~에 더하여). 다섯째, 닿지 않은 채 위에 걸쳐 있음, 나아가 인접·근접(~곁에). 여섯째, 움직임과 함께 쓰여 방향(~를 향하여)이나 적대(~에 맞서). 합성형 מֵעַל은 '~위로부터'입니다.

H0834a.d: אֲשֶׁר part. of relation A sign of relation, bringing the clause introduced by it into relation with an antecedent clause
H0834a.sd: who, which, what, that; also (as an adverb and a conjunction) when, where, how, because, in order that, etc — × after, × alike, as (soon as), because, × every, for, + forasmuch, + from whence, + how(-soever), × if, (so) that ((thing) which, wherein), × though, + until, + whatsoever, when, where (+ -as, -in, -of, -on, -soever, -with), which, whilst, + whither(-soever), who(-m, -soever, -se). As it is indeclinable, it is often accompanied by the personal pronoun expletively, used to show the connection
H0834a.kd: אֲשֶׁר — 관계 불변화사. 자기가 이끄는 절을 앞선 선행사와 이어 주는 표지입니다. 우리말의 관형절 어미 '~하는'에 해당하며, 문맥에 따라 '누구, 무엇, ~한 것'으로 옮깁니다. 부사나 접속사로도 쓰여 '~할 때, ~하는 곳에서, ~이므로, ~하도록'의 뜻을 냅니다. 격변화를 하지 않기 때문에 인칭대명사를 덧붙여 관계를 분명히 하는 경우가 많습니다.

H3808.sd: not (the simple or abs. negation); by implication, no; often used with other particles — × before, or else, ere, except, ig(-norant), much, less, nay, neither, never, no((-ne), -r, (-thing)), (× as though...,(can-), for) not (out of), of nought, otherwise, out of, surely, as truly as, of a truth, verily, for want, whether, without
H3808.kd: לֹא (또는 לוֹא) — 부사. '아니다'. 단순하고 절대적인 부정을 나타냅니다. 함의상 '없다, 아무것도 아니다'로도 쓰이며, 다른 불변화사와 결합해 '~하기 전에, 그렇지 않으면, ~을 제외하고, 결코 ~않다' 등 여러 부정 표현을 이룹니다. 금지를 나타낼 때는 십계명처럼 '~하지 말라'가 됩니다.

H3045.d: יָדַע 943 vb. know; Qal; know, learn to know; perceive; perceive and see; find out and discern; discriminate, distinguish; know by experience; recognize, admit, acknowledge, confess; consider; not know = not expect; know a person, be acquainted with; know a person carnally, of sexual intercourse; know how, to do a thing, be able to do it; be skilful in; abs. have knowledge, be wise; Niph; be made known, be or become known, of things; make oneself known of pers; be perceived; be instructed; Pi. cause to know; Pu. known; Hiph. make known, declare; Hoph. made known; Hithp. make oneself known
H3045.sd: to know (properly, to ascertain by seeing); used in a great variety of senses, figuratively, literally, euphemistically and inferentially (including observation, care, recognition; and causatively, instruction, designation, punishment, etc.) — acknowledge, acquaintance(-ted with), advise, answer, appoint, assuredly, be aware, (un-) awares, can(-not), certainly, comprehend, consider, × could they, cunning, declare, be diligent, (can, cause to) discern, discover, endued with, familiar friend, famous, feel, can have, be (ig-) norant, instruct, kinsfolk, kinsman, (cause to let, make) know, (come to give, have, take) knowledge, have (knowledge), (be, make, make to be, make self) known, be learned, lie by man, mark, perceive, privy to, × prognosticator, regard, have respect, skilful, shew, can (man of) skill, be sure, of a surety, teach, (can) tell, understand, have (understanding), × will be, wist, wit, wot
H3045.kd: יָדַע — 동사, 약 943회. '알다'. 칼형에서 (1) 알다, 알게 되다, (2) 깨닫다, 알아보다, (3) 알아내어 분간하다, (4) 겪어서 알다, (5) 인정하다, 시인하다, 자백하다, (6) 헤아리다, (7) '알지 못하다'에서 '예상하지 못하다', (8) 사람을 알다 곧 사귀어 알다, (9) 완곡어법으로 남녀가 동침하다, (10) 할 줄 알다, 능하다, (11) 홀로 쓰여 '지식이 있다, 지혜롭다'. 니팔형은 '알려지다, 자신을 알리다, 깨달아지다, 배우다'. 피엘형은 '알게 하다'. 히필형은 '알리다, 선포하다'. 히트파엘형은 '자신을 드러내다'. 히브리어의 '알다'는 눈으로 보아 확인하는 데서 출발해 관심과 돌봄, 인정까지 아우릅니다.

H0559.d: אָמַר 5287 vb. utter, say; Qal; Say; Say in the heart (= think); Promise; Command (esp. late); Niph. be said, told; Hiph. avow, avouch (lit. cause to declare); Hithp. act proudly, boast
H0559.sd: to say (used with great latitude) — answer, appoint, avouch, bid, boast self, call, certify, challenge, charge, (at the, give) command(-ment), commune, consider, declare, demand, × desire, determine, × expressly, × indeed, × intend, name, × plainly, promise, publish, report, require, say, speak (against, of), × still, × suppose, talk, tell, term, × that is, × think, use (speech), utter, × verily, × yet
H0559.kd: אָמַר — 동사, 약 5,287회. '말하다, 이르다'. 칼형에서 (1) 말하다, (2) 마음속으로 말하다 곧 '생각하다', (3) 약속하다, (4) 명령하다(특히 후기 용법). 니팔형은 '말해지다, 전해지다'. 히필형은 '선언하게 하다'에서 나와 '공언하다, 서약하다'. 히트파엘형은 '교만하게 굴다, 자랑하다'. 히브리어에서 가장 널리 쓰이는 말하기 동사로, 대답하다·명하다·부르다·알리다 등 문맥에 따라 매우 다양하게 옮겨집니다.

H0413.d: אֶל (nearly always followed by Makkeph), prep. denoting motion to or direction towards (whether physical or mental); of motion to or unto a person or place; Where the limit is actually entered, into; Of direction towards anything; Where the motion or direction implied appears from the context to be of a hostile character, אֶל = against; Unto sometimes acquires from the context the sense of in addition to; Metaph. in regard to, concerning, on account of; Of rule or standard according to (rare); Expressing presence at a spot, against, at, by, not merely after verbs implying motion; Prefixed to other preps. it combines with them the idea of motion or direction to
H0413.sd: near, with or among; often in general, to — about, according to, after, against, among, as for, at, because(-fore, -side), both...and, by, concerning, for, from, × hath, in(-to), near, (out) of, over, through, to(-ward), under, unto, upon, whether, with(-in)
H0413.kd: אֶל — 물리적이든 심리적이든 '~를 향한 움직임·방향'을 나타내는 전치사입니다. 첫째, 사람이나 장소로 향하여(~에게, ~로). 둘째, 그 경계 안으로 실제로 들어가면 '~안으로'. 셋째, 문맥이 적대적이면 '~에 맞서, ~를 대적하여'. 넷째, '~에 더하여'라는 뜻을 얻기도 합니다. 다섯째, 비유적으로 '~에 관하여, ~때문에'. 여섯째, 드물게 기준을 나타내어 '~에 따라'. 일곱째, 움직임을 함의하는 동사가 아니어도 어떤 지점에 있음을 나타내어 '~곁에, ~에'로 쓰입니다. 다른 전치사 앞에 붙어 그 전치사에 방향의 뜻을 더하기도 합니다.

H5971a.d: עַם, עָם 1810 n.m. people; a people, nation; = smaller units; = common people; people in gen., persons; phrases
H5971a.sd: a people (as a congregated unit); specifically, a tribe (as those of Israel); hence (collectively) troops or attendants; figuratively, a flock — folk, men, nation, people
H5971a.kd: עַם — 남성명사, 약 1,810회. '백성'. 첫째, 한 백성, 민족. 둘째, 더 작은 단위의 무리. 셋째, 지도층과 구별되는 '일반 백성'. 넷째, 널리 '사람들'. 스트롱은 하나로 모인 단위로서의 백성, 특히 이스라엘의 지파, 나아가 집합적으로 군대나 수행원, 비유적으로 떼를 가리킨다고 봅니다. '그 땅의 백성'(암 하아레츠) 같은 어구를 이룹니다.

H2009.d: הִנֵּה, once הִנֶּה־, demonstr.part. lo!, behold!
H2009.kd: הִנֵּה — 지시 불변화사. '보라!' 눈앞에 무엇이 있음을 가리켜 듣는 이의 주의를 끄는 말로, 이야기의 흐름에서 새로운 장면이나 뜻밖의 사실을 들여올 때 씁니다. 우리말로는 '보라, 자, 이제'로 옮기거나, 문맥에 따라 굳이 옮기지 않기도 합니다.

H7227a.d: רַב 429 adj. much, many, great; (oft. opp. מְעַט); much: of substances; esp. of collectives, numerous; pl. many; רַב as subst. coll. pers; cstr. = abounding in; מִן comp. = more numerous than; רַב = abundant, enough; as adv. much, exceedingly; less oft. great
H7227a.sd: abundant (in quantity, size, age, number, rank, quality) — (in) abound(-undance, -ant, -antly), captain, elder, enough, exceedingly, full, great(-ly, man, one), increase, long (enough, (time)), (do, have) many(-ifold, things, a time), (ship-)master, mighty, more, (too, very) much, multiply(-tude), officer, often(-times), plenteous, populous, prince, process (of time), suffice(-lent)
H7227a.kd: רַב — 형용사, 약 429회. '많은, 큰'. 자주 מְעַט('적은')와 짝을 이룹니다. 물질에 대해서는 '많은', 집합명사에 대해서는 '수가 많은', 복수로는 '여럿'이 됩니다. 사람을 가리키는 명사처럼 쓰이기도 하고, 연계형으로 '~이 풍성한'이 됩니다. 비교의 מִן과 함께 쓰면 '~보다 많은'. '넉넉하다, 충분하다'는 뜻도 있고, 부사로 '심히, 매우'가 됩니다. 덜 자주 '큰, 위대한'이라는 뜻으로도 쓰여 관직 이름('~장관')에 들어갑니다.

H6099.sd: powerful (specifically, a paw); by implication, numerous — feeble, great, mighty, must, strong

H4480a.d: מִן־, and מִ, before יְ, prep. expressing the idea of separation, hence out of, from, on account of, off, on the side of, since, above, than, so that not; with verbs expressing (or implying) separation or removal; from, against; מן also, without a verb of similar significance, sometimes expresses the idea of separation, away from, far from; of position, off, on the side of, on; Out of, Gk. ἐκ, Lat. ex; Partitively; Of time—; as marking the terminus a quo, the anterior limit of a continuous period from, since; as marking the period immediately succeeding the limit after; towards, to; (וְעַד) עַד … מִן from … even to; In comparisons, beyond, above; מן is prefixed to an infin.: with causal force, from, on account of, through; after verbs implying restraint, prevention, cessation, etc; with a temporal force, since, after; Once as a conj. before a finite verb. that; In compounds
H4480a.sd: properly, a part of; hence (prepositionally), from or out of in many senses — above, after, among, at, because of, by (reason of), from (among), in, × neither, × nor, (out) of, over, since, × then, through, × whether, with
H4480a.kd: מִן — '분리'의 개념을 나타내는 전치사로, 여기서 '~에서 나와, ~로부터, ~때문에, ~쪽에, ~이래로, ~보다'라는 여러 뜻이 갈라져 나옵니다. 첫째, 떠남·옮김을 뜻하는 동사와 함께 '~로부터'. 둘째, 그런 동사가 없어도 '~에서 떨어져, ~에서 멀리'. 셋째, 위치를 나타내어 '~쪽에'. 넷째, '~밖으로'(헬라어 ἐκ, 라틴어 ex에 해당). 다섯째, 부분을 나타내어 '~중의 일부'. 여섯째, 시간의 시작점을 나타내어 '~이래로', 또는 그 직후를 나타내어 '~후에'. 일곱째, 비교에서 '~보다 더'. 여덟째, 부정사 앞에 붙어 원인('~때문에')이나 금지·중지('~하지 못하도록')를 나타냅니다.

H3051.d: [יָהַב] vb. give; give; = set; with reflex. = provide; ascribe glory, etc; = come now (orig. grant, permit)
H3051.sd: to give (whether literal or figurative); generally, to put; imperatively (reflexive) come — ascribe, bring, come on, give, go, set, take

H2449.d: חָכַם vb. be wise; Qal be or become wise, act wisely; Pi. make wise, teach wisdom; Pu. made wise, intensive, as it were the embodiment of wisdom; Hiph. making wise the simple; Hithp. let us deal wisely (shrewdly) toward it (the people); make or shew thyself wise
H2449.sd: to be wise (in mind, word or act) — × exceeding, teach wisdom, be (make self, shew self) wise, deal (never so) wisely, make wiser

H6435.d: פֶּן־ 133 (alw. with Makkeph) conj. (adverting or deprecating), lest; with impf; with Pf., the result feared being conceived as having possibly already taken place
H6435.sd: properly, removal; used only (in the construction) adverb as conjunction, lest — (lest) (peradventure), that...not

H3588a.d: כִּי conj. that, for, when; that; Of time, when, of the past; elsewhere כִּי has a force approximating to if, though it usu. represents a case as more likely to occur than אִם; when or if, with a concessive force, i.e. though; Because, since
H3588a.sd: (by implication) very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb (as below); often largely modified by other particles annexed — and, (forasmuch, inasmuch, where-) as, assured(-ly), but, certainly, doubtless, else, even, except, for, how, (because, in, so, than) that, nevertheless, now, rightly, seeing, since, surely, then, therefore, (al-) though, till, truly, until, when, whether, while, whom, yea, yet
H3588a.kd: כִּי — 접속사. '~라는 것, ~때문에, ~할 때'. 첫째, 명사절을 이끌어 '~라는 것을'. 둘째, 시간을 나타내어 과거 사건에 대해 '~했을 때'. 셋째, 조건을 나타내어 '만일 ~하면'인데, 아래 אִם과 달리 일어날 가능성이 더 높은 경우를 가리킵니다. 넷째, 양보의 힘을 지녀 '비록 ~할지라도'. 다섯째, 이유를 나타내어 '~이므로, ~때문에'. 부정문 뒤에서는 '오히려, 도리어'로 옮기는 것이 자연스럽습니다.

H7122.d: [קָרָא] 137 vb. encounter, befall; Qal 131; meet, encounter; fig. befall; Niph. meet unexpectedly; Hiph. thou didst cause all this evil to befall them
H7122.sd: to encounter, whether accidentally or in a hostile manner — befall, (by) chance, (cause to) come (upon), fall out, happen, meet

H4421.sd: a battle (i.e. the engagement); generally, war (i.e. war-fare) — battle, fight(-ing), war(-rior)

H3254.d: יָסַף 214 vb. add; Qal add; Niph; join (intr.), join oneself to; be joined, added to; Hiph; add; sq. inf. add to do = do again or more; sq. Impf; sq. Impf. asynd
H3254.sd: to add or augment (often adverbial, to continue to do a thing) — add, × again, × any more, × cease, × come more, conceive again, continue, exceed, × further, × gather together, get more, give more-over, × henceforth, increase (more and more), join, × longer (bring, do, make, much, put), × (the, much, yet) more (and more), proceed (further), prolong, put, be (strong-) er, × yet, yield

H1571.d: גַּם 768 adv. denoting addition, also, moreover, yea
H1571.sd: properly, assemblage; used only adverbially also, even, yea, though; often repeated as correl. both...and — again, alike, also, (so much) as (soon), both (so)...and, but, either...or, even, for all, (in) likewise (manner), moreover, nay...neither, one, then(-refore), though, what, with, yea
H1571.kd: גַּם — 더함을 나타내는 부사. '또한, 게다가, 참으로'. 스트롱은 본디 '모임'을 뜻하던 말이 부사로만 쓰이게 된 것으로 봅니다. 되풀이해 짝을 이루면 '~도 ~도'가 되고, 문맥에 따라 '~조차, 비록 ~일지라도'라는 양보의 뜻도 냅니다.

H8130.d: שָׂנֵא 145 vb. hate; Qal 128 hate; Niph. is hated; Pi. enemy
H8130.sd: to hate (personally) — enemy, foe, (be) hate(-ful, -r), odious, × utterly

H3898a.d: [לָחַם] 171 vb. fight, do battle; Qal fight, do battle; Niph. engage in battle (recipr.), sometimes wage war
H3898a.sd: to feed on; figuratively, to consume; by implication, to battle (as destruction) — devour, eat, × ever, fight(-ing), overcome, prevail, (make) war(-ring)

H5927.d: עָלָה 890 vb. go up, ascend, climb; Qal; of persons, go up, ascend, in local relations; go up, in personal relations; of animals, go or come up; of vegetation, spring up, grow, shoot forth; of natural phenom., go up, rise; of inanimate things, instead of passive construction; of thoughts; come up before God, arrogance; go up, extend, of boundary; excel; Niph; be brought up; be taken up; pass., be taken up, away; reflex., take oneself away from, get up from; reflex.: take oneself away; be exalted, of God; Hiph; bring up persons; in personal relations; bring up animals; cause to ascend; mentally; offer a present; bring up tithe to; exalt; cause to ascend (in flame), offer sacrifice; Hoph; be carried away; be taken up into, inserted in; be offered; Hithp. lift oneself
H5927.sd: to ascend, intransitively (be high) or actively (mount); used in a great variety of senses, primary and secondary, literal and figurative — arise (up), (cause to) ascend up, at once, break (the day) (up), bring (up), (cause to) burn, carry up, cast up, shew, climb (up), (cause to, make to) come (up), cut off, dawn, depart, exalt, excel, fall, fetch up, get up, (make to) go (away, up); grow (over) increase, lay, leap, levy, lift (self) up, light, (make) up, × mention, mount up, offer, make to pay, perfect, prefer, put (on), raise, recover, restore, (make to) rise (up), scale, set (up), shoot forth (up), (begin to) spring (up), stir up, take away (up), work
H5927.kd: עָלָה — 동사, 약 890회. '오르다, 올라가다'. 칼형에서 사람이 장소를 옮겨 올라가는 것이 기본이고, 사람 사이의 관계에서 나아가는 것, 짐승이 올라오는 것, 초목이 돋아 자라는 것, 해나 연기 같은 자연 현상이 떠오르는 것, 생각이 떠오르는 것, 하나님 앞에 상달되는 것, 경계선이 뻗어 가는 것, 남보다 뛰어난 것에까지 두루 쓰입니다. 니팔형은 '올려지다, 데려가지다, 물러가다', 하나님에 대해서는 '높임을 받으시다'. 히필형은 '올라가게 하다, 데리고 올라가다, 바치다'로, 특히 제물을 불살라 올리는 번제를 가리키는 말이 여기서 나왔습니다. 십일조를 드리는 것, 높이는 것에도 씁니다. 호팔형은 '옮겨지다, 끼워 넣어지다, 드려지다'. 히트파엘형은 '스스로 높아지다'.

H7760a.d: שׂוּם, שִׂים 582 vb. put, place, set; Qal; put, set, in a place; put something upon; put, lay, set; put, c. בֵּין; set, direct; set, ordain, in a place; set, establish a law, statute; set, found a nation; set, appoint (as ruler, official); set, constitute, make; set, determine, fix, bounds; set, station, at a post; put in position, sacred bread, sword, staves, bars; set up altars; = plant, wheat; set, fix (countenance); make a thing, or pers. (acc.), for, transform into; make, constitute; work, bring to pass; appoint, give; set, fix (countenance); Hiph. I will make him for a sign; Hoph. there was set before him
H7760a.sd: to put (used in a great variety of applications, literal, figurative, inferentially, and elliptically) — × any wise, appoint, bring, call (a name), care, cast in, change, charge, commit, consider, convey, determine, disguise, dispose, do, get, give, heap up, hold, impute, lay (down, up), leave, look, make (out), mark, name, × on, ordain, order, paint, place, preserve, purpose, put (on), regard, rehearse, reward, (cause to) set (on, up), shew, stedfastly, take, × tell, tread down, (over-)turn, × wholly, work
H7760a.kd: שׂוּם (또는 שִׂים) — 동사, 약 582회. '두다, 놓다, 세우다'. 칼형에서 어떤 자리에 두다, 위에 얹다, 사이에 두다, 향하게 하다, 정하여 두다, 법과 규례를 세우다, 나라를 세우다, 통치자나 관리로 세우다, 삼다·만들다, 경계를 정하다, 자리에 배치하다, 진설병이나 칼이나 채나 빗장을 제자리에 놓다, 제단을 쌓다, 밀을 심다, 얼굴을 향하여 고정하다, 무엇을 무엇으로 바꾸어 놓다, 이루다, 주다로 두루 쓰입니다. 히필형은 '표징으로 삼겠다', 호팔형은 '그 앞에 놓였다'. 우리말로는 '두다, 놓다, 삼다, 세우다, 정하다'로 문맥에 맞추어 옮깁니다.

H8269.d: שַׂר 420 n.m. chieftain, chief, ruler, official, captain, prince
H8269.sd: a head person (of any rank or class) — captain (that had rule), chief (captain), general, governor, keeper, lord,(-task-)master, prince(-ipal), ruler, steward
H8269.kd: שַׂר — 남성명사, 약 420회. '우두머리, 관원, 방백, 장관'. 군대의 지휘관, 관청의 책임자, 한 지역의 통치자 등 계급을 가리지 않고 윗자리에 있는 사람을 두루 가리킵니다. 문맥에 따라 '천부장, 감독, 대장, 고관'으로 옮깁니다.

H4522.d: מַס n.m. usu. coll. body of forced labourers, task-workers, labour-band or gang, also (late) forced service, task-work, serfdom
H4522.sd: properly, a burden (as causing to faint), i.e. a tax in the form of forced labor — discomfited, levy, task(-master), tribute(-tary)

H4616.d: [מַ֫עַן] subst. purpose, intent, only with לְ, in לְמַ֫עַן 271 prep. and conj. for the sake of, on account of, to the intent or in order that
H4616.sd: properly, heed, i.e. purpose; used only adverbially, on account of (as a motive or an aim), teleologically, in order that — because of, to the end (intent) that, for (to,... 's sake), lest, that, to

H6031b.d: [עָנָה] vb. be bowed down, afflicted; Qal; be put down or become low, of song of triumph; be depressed, downcast; be afflicted; Niph; humble oneself; be afflicted; Pi; humble, mishandle, afflict; humble, a woman by cohabit; afflict as a discipline; humble, weaken; Pu; be afflicted, in discipline by God; be humbled by fasting; Hiph. afflict, in discipline; Hithp; humble oneself; be afflicted; humble oneself in fasting
H6031b.sd: to depress literally or figuratively, transitive or intransitive (in various applications, as follows) — abase self, afflict(-ion, self), answer (by mistake for 6030), chasten self, deal hardly with, defile, exercise, force, gentleness, humble (self), hurt, ravish, sing (by mistake for 6030), speak (by mistake for 6030), submit self, weaken, × in any wise

H1129.d: בָּנָה 373 vb. build; Qal build; Niph; be built; be rebuilt; (fig.) of restored exiles, = established; established, made permanent
H1129.sd: to build (literally and figuratively) — (begin to) build(-er), obtain children, make, repair, set (up), × surely
H1129.kd: בָּנָה — 동사, 약 373회. '세우다, 건축하다'. 칼형은 '짓다'. 니팔형은 '지어지다, 다시 지어지다'이며, 비유적으로 사로잡혔다 돌아온 이들이 '세워지다' 곧 든든히 서게 되는 것을 뜻합니다. 스트롱은 '자식을 얻다'는 뜻으로도 쓰인다고 밝히는데, 아들을 통해 집안이 세워진다는 히브리적 표현입니다. '집을 세우다'가 곧 '가문을 잇다'가 되는 말놀이가 여기서 나옵니다.

H5892b.d: עִיר 1092 n.f. city, town; city, town, abode of men; of fortress in a city; appar. fortified place, of any size
H5892b.sd: a city (a place guarded by waking or a watch) in the widest sense (even of a mere encampment or post) — Ai (from margin), city, court (from margin), town
H5892b.kd: עִיר — 여성명사, 약 1,092회. '성읍, 도시'. 첫째, 사람이 모여 사는 곳으로서의 성읍·마을. 둘째, 성읍 안의 요새를 가리키기도 합니다. 셋째, 크기와 상관없이 성벽으로 둘러친 곳을 두루 이릅니다. 스트롱은 이 말이 '깨어 지킨다'는 뜻에서 나와 파수로 지켜지는 곳을 가리킨다고 보며, 그래서 진영이나 초소처럼 작은 곳에도 쓰인다고 설명합니다.

H6547.d: פַּרְעֹה 275 n.m. Pharaoh, title of Egyptian kings
H6547.sd: Paroh, a general title of Egyptian kings — Pharaoh

H6619.sd: Pithom, a place in Egypt — Pithom

H7486.d: רַֽעַמְסֵס n.pr.loc., = רַעְמְסֵס, Ramses, city in Egypt
H7486.sd: Rameses or Raamses, a place in Egypt — Raamses, Rameses

H0834d.d: כַּאֲשֶׁר conj. according as, as, when; according to that which, according as, as; with a causal force, in so far as, since; with a temporal force, when
H0834d.sd: who, which, what, that; also (as an adverb and a conjunction) when, where, how, because, in order that, etc — × after, × alike, as (soon as), because, × every, for, + forasmuch, + from whence, + how(-soever), × if, (so) that ((thing) which, wherein), × though, + until, + whatsoever, when, where (+ -as, -in, -of, -on, -soever, -with), which, whilst, + whither(-soever), who(-m, -soever, -se). As it is indeclinable, it is often accompanied by the personal pronoun expletively, used to show the connection
H0834d.kd: כַּאֲשֶׁר — 전치사 כְּ와 관계사 אֲשֶׁר가 합해진 접속사. 첫째, '~한 그대로, ~와 같이'. 둘째, 이유를 나타내어 '~인 만큼, ~이므로'. 셋째, 시간을 나타내어 '~할 때'. 성경에서 매우 자주 나오는 접속사로, '여호와께서 명하신 대로'와 같은 어구를 이룹니다.

H3651c.sd: properly, set upright; hence (figuratively as adjective) just; but usually (as adverb or conjunction) rightly or so (in various applications to manner, time and relation; often with other particles) — after that (this, -ward, -wards), as... as, (for-) asmuch as yet, be (for which) cause, following, howbeit, in (the) like (manner, -wise), × the more, right, (even) so, state, straightway, such (thing), surely, there (where) -fore, this, thus, true, well, × you
H3651c.kd: כֵּן — 부사, 약 738회. '그렇게, 그리하여'. 스트롱은 본디 '똑바로 세워진'이라는 뜻이었고, 여기서 형용사로 '옳은, 바른'이라는 뜻이, 다시 부사·접속사로 '옳게, 그렇게'라는 뜻이 나왔다고 봅니다. 방식·시간·관계를 나타내는 여러 자리에 두루 쓰이며, 다른 불변화사와 어울려 '그러므로, 그런즉, 그 후에, 이와 같이, 참으로'가 됩니다.

H6555.d: פָּרַץ vb. break through; Qal; break or burst out; break through, down (from without); break into; break open, a mining shaft; break up, break in pieces; break out (violently) upon; use violence; break over [limits], increase; burst open, intrans., of wine vats; spread, i.e. become known; Niph. no vision spread abroad; Hithp. slaves who break away
H6555.sd: to break out (in many applications, direct and indirect, literal and figurative) — × abroad, (make a) breach, break (away, down, -er, forth, in, up), burst out, come (spread) abroad, compel, disperse, grow, increase, open, press, scatter, urge

H6973.d: [קוּץ] vb. feel a loathing, abhorrence, sickening dread; Qal; feel a loathing at, abhor; feel a sickening dread; Hiph. let us cause he sickening dread
H6973.sd: to be (causatively, make) disgusted or anxious — abhor, be distressed, be grieved, loathe, vex, be weary

H6440.d: [פָּנֶה], pl. פָּנִים 2123 n.m. face, also faces; face, faces; presence, person; technically, see one's face, i.e. appear before one, in one's presence; face of seraphim; face of animals; face (= surface) of ground; as adv.loc. before; for other phrases; with prepositions
H6440.sd: the face (as the part that turns); used in a great variety of applications (literally and figuratively); also (with prepositional prefix) as a preposition (before, etc.) — accept, a-(be-) fore(-time), against, anger, × as (long as), at, battle, because (of), beseech, countenance, edge, employ, endure, enquire, face, favour, fear of, for, forefront(-part), form(-er time, -ward), from, front, heaviness, × him(-self), honourable, impudent, in, it, look(-eth) (-s), × me, meet, × more than, mouth, of, off, (of) old (time), × on, open, out of, over against, the partial, person, please, presence, propect, was purposed, by reason of, regard, right forth, serve, × shewbread, sight, state, straight, street, × thee, × them(-selves), through ( -out), till, time(-s) past, (un-) to(-ward), upon, upside ( down), with(-in, -stand), × ye, × you
H6440.kd: פָּנִים — 남성명사(복수형으로만 쓰임), 약 2,123회. '얼굴'. 첫째, 얼굴, 낯. 둘째, 임재, 면전, 그리고 사람 자체. '어떤 이의 얼굴을 본다'는 것은 그 앞에 나아가 뵙는다는 기술적 표현입니다. 셋째, 스랍의 얼굴, 짐승의 얼굴. 넷째, 땅의 '표면'. 다섯째, 장소 부사로 '~앞에'. 여러 전치사와 결합해 לִפְנֵי '~앞에서', מִפְּנֵי '~앞에서부터·~때문에' 같은 표현을 이룹니다. 하나님의 '얼굴'은 그분의 임재와 은총을 가리키는 말로 자주 쓰입니다.

H5647.d: עָבַד 290 vb. work, serve; Qal; labour, work, do work; work for another, serve him by labour; serve as subjects; serve God; serve י׳ with Levitical service; Niph; be tilled, of land; dub. cultivated field; Pu. worked; Hiph; compel to labour as slaves; make to serve as subjects; cause to serve God; Hoph. be led or enticed to serve
H5647.sd: to work (in any sense); by implication, to serve, till, (causatively) enslave, etc — × be, keep in bondage, be bondmen, bond-service, compel, do, dress, ear, execute, husbandman, keep, labour(-ing man, bring to pass, (cause to, make to) serve(-ing, self), (be, become) servant(-s), do (use) service, till(-er), transgress (from margin), (set a) work, be wrought, worshipper

H4713.sd: a Mitsrite, or inhabitant of Mitsrajim — Egyptian, of Egypt

H4843.d: מָרַר vb. be bitter; Qal be bitter; Pi. make bitter, shew bitterness; Hiph. make bitter, shew bitterness; Hithpalp. and the king of the south shall embitter himself (be enraged)
H4843.sd: to be (causatively, make) bitter (literally or figuratively) — (be, be in, deal, have, make) bitter(-ly, -ness), be moved with choler, (be, have sorely, it) grieved(-eth), provoke, vex

H2416e.d: חַיִּים n.m. pl. abstr. emph. life; life: physical; life: as welfare and happiness in king's presence; sustenance, maintenance
H2416e.sd: alive; hence, raw (flesh); fresh (plant, water, year), strong; also (as noun, especially in the feminine singular and masculine plural) life (or living thing), whether literally or figuratively — age, alive, appetite, (wild) beast, company, congregation, life(-time), live(-ly), living (creature, thing), maintenance, merry, multitude, (be) old, quick, raw, running, springing, troop

H5656.d: עֲבֹדָה, and (Chr) עֲבוֹדָה 146 n.f. labour, service; labour, work; labour of servant or slave; labour, service of captives or subjects; service of God
H5656.sd: work of any kind — act, bondage, bondservant, effect, labour, ministering(-try), office, service(-ile, -itude), tillage, use, work, × wrought

H7186.sd: severe (in various applications) — churlish, cruel, grievous, hard((-hearted), thing), heavy, impudent, obstinate, prevailed, rough(-ly), sore, sorrowful, stiff(necked), stubborn, in trouble

H2563a.sd: properly, a bubbling up, i.e. of water, a wave; of earth, mire or clay (cement); also a heap; hence, a chomer or dry measure — clay, heap, homer, mire, motion

H3843.d: לְבֵנָה n.f. brick, tile; brick, as building-material; = tile, on which plan of city could be engraved; = pavement
H3843.sd: a brick (from the whiteness of the clay) — (altar of) brick, tile

H7704b.d: שָׂדֶה 819 n.m. id. [u.ak.ab] (ordinary contr. form); open field, country; definite portion of ground, field, land; land, opp. sea
H7704b.sd: a field (as flat) — country, field, ground, land, soil, × wild
H7704b.kd: שָׂדֶה — 남성명사, 약 320회. '들, 밭'. 첫째, 성 밖의 트인 벌판 곧 들. 둘째, 경계가 정해진 한 뙈기의 땅 곧 밭. 셋째, 바다에 대비되는 뭍. '들짐승'은 곧 사람의 손이 닿지 않은 야생의 짐승입니다.

H3205.d: יָלַד 497 vb. bear, bring forth, beget; Qal; bear, bring forth; less often beget; of both parents; Niph. be born; Pi. cause (or help) to bring forth, viz., assist or tend as midwife; Pu. be born; Hiph; beget (a father a child); bear; Hoph. day of one's being born = birthday; Hithp. declared their pedigree
H3205.sd: to bear young; causatively, to beget; medically, to act as midwife; specifically, to show lineage — bear, beget, birth(-day), born, (make to) bring forth (children, young), bring up, calve, child, come, be delivered (of a child), time of delivery, gender, hatch, labour, (do the office of a) midwife, declare pedigrees, be the son of, (woman in, woman that) travail(-eth, -ing woman)
H3205.kd: יָלַד — 동사, 약 497회. '낳다'. 칼형은 (1) 여자가 아이를 낳다, (2) 덜 자주 남자가 자식을 얻다, (3) 양친을 함께 가리키기도 합니다. 니팔형은 '태어나다'. 피엘형은 산파 노릇을 하여 '해산을 돕다'. 푸알형은 '태어나다'. 히필형은 아버지가 '낳다'. 호팔형은 '태어난 날' 곧 생일. 히트파엘형은 '족보를 밝히다'. 창세기 족보의 '아무개를 낳았고'가 바로 이 말입니다.

H5680.sd: an Eberite (i.e. Hebrew) or descendant of Eber — Hebrew(-ess, woman)

H0259.d: אֶחָד 972 adj.num. one; one; = each, every; = a certain; = indef. art; only, & (fem.) once; one … another, one … the other; as ordinal first; in combin
H0259.sd: properly, united, i.e. one; or (as an ordinal) first — a, alike, alone, altogether, and, any(-thing), apiece, a certain, (dai-) ly, each (one), eleven, every, few, first, highway, a man, once, one, only, other, some, together
H0259.kd: אֶחָד — 수사, 약 972회. '하나'. 첫째, 수 하나. 둘째, '각각, 모두'. 셋째, '어떤 하나'. 넷째, 우리말에 없는 부정관사처럼 쓰여 '한 ~'. 다섯째, '오직'의 뜻, 여성형은 '한 번'. 여섯째, 짝을 이루어 '하나는 ~ 다른 하나는 ~'. 일곱째, 서수로 '첫째'. 스트롱은 본디 '하나로 합해진'이 이 말의 뜻이라고 봅니다.

H8145.d: שֵׁנִי m. שֵׁנִית f. 157 adj.num.ord. second
H8145.sd: properly, double, i.e. second; also adverbially, again — again, either (of them), (an-) other, second (time)

H7200.d: רָאָה 1315 vb. see; Qal 1141; see, subj; see, c. acc. rei; see, sq. acc. cl. or phr. of closer design; see, so as to learn to know; abs. see, have (power of) vision; see = perceive; look at, see, by direct volition; of mental observation; c. ב, lit., look into, hence look at with interest; see, c. acc. rei; Niph; appear; be seen; be visible; Pu. appar. his bones are not detected; Hithp. recipr. look at each other; Hiph; cause one to see something, shew; cause to experience something; cause to look intently at, to behold; Hoph; be caused to see, be shewn; be exhibited to
H7200.sd: to see, literally or figuratively (in numerous applications, direct and implied, transitive, intransitive and causative) — advise self, appear, approve, behold, × certainly, consider, discern, (make to) enjoy, have experience, gaze, take heed, × indeed, × joyfully, lo, look (on, one another, one on another, one upon another, out, up, upon), mark, meet, × be near, perceive, present, provide, regard, (have) respect, (fore-, cause to, let) see(-r, -m, one another), shew (self), × sight of others, (e-) spy, stare, × surely, × think, view, visions
H7200.kd: רָאָה — 동사, 약 1,315회. '보다'. 칼형(1,141회)에서 보다, 무엇을 보다, 보아서 알게 되다, 볼 힘이 있다, 지각하다, 뜻을 두고 바라보다, 마음으로 살피다, בְּ와 함께 '~을 들여다보다·관심을 가지고 바라보다'. 니팔형은 '나타나다, 보이다'. 히트파엘형은 서로 '마주 보다'. 히필형은 '보게 하다, 보이다', '겪게 하다', '똑똑히 보게 하다'. 호팔형은 '보임을 받다, 드러내 보여지다'. 선견자를 뜻하는 로에가 이 동사에서 나왔습니다.

H0070.d: [אֹבֶן] n.[m.] wheel, disc; potter’s wheel; prob. bearing-stool, midwife’s stool
H0070.sd: a pair of stones (only dual); a potter's wheel or a midwife's stool (consisting alike of two horizontal disks with a support between) — wheel, stool

H0518a.d: אִם conj; hypoth. part. if; Interrog. part
H0518a.sd: used very widely as demonstrative, lo!; interrogative, whether?; or conditional, if, although; also Oh that!, when; hence, as a negative, not — (and, can-, doubtless, if, that) (not), + but, either, + except, + more(-over if, than), neither, nevertheless, nor, oh that, or, + save (only, -ing), seeing, since, sith, + surely (no more, none, not), though, + of a truth, + unless, + verily, when, whereas, whether, while, + yet
H0518a.kd: אִם — 접속사. 첫째, 조건을 나타내는 불변화사로 '만일 ~하면'. 둘째, 의문을 나타내는 불변화사로 '~인가?'. 맹세문에서는 강한 부정이 되어 '결코 ~하지 않겠다'는 뜻이 되고, 반대로 אִם לֹא는 강한 긍정이 됩니다. 짝을 이루면 '~이든 ~이든'이 되고, 소원을 나타내어 '아, ~라면'으로 쓰이기도 합니다. 문맥에 따라 '비록, 그러나, ~을 제외하고, ~할 때'로도 옮깁니다.

H1323.d: בַּת 587 n.f. daughter; daughter, female child; young women, women; with name of city, land, or people, poet. personif. of that city or inhabitants; pl. = villages, after name of city; in phrases denoting character, quality, etc; ostrich; fig; of vine = branch; as n. relat
H1323.sd: a daughter (used in the same wide sense as other terms of relationship, literally and figuratively) — apple (of the eye), branch, company, daughter, × first, × old, owl, town, village
H1323.kd: בַּת — 여성명사, 약 587회. '딸'. 첫째, 딸, 여자아이. 둘째, 젊은 여자, 여인들. 셋째, 성읍이나 땅이나 백성의 이름과 함께 쓰여 그 성읍이나 주민을 사람처럼 부르는 시적 표현('시온의 딸'). 넷째, 성읍 이름 뒤에 복수로 쓰이면 그에 딸린 '마을들'. 다섯째, 성질이나 특징을 나타내는 말과 함께 쓰여 그러한 자를 뜻합니다. 여섯째, 타조를 가리키는 합성어에 쓰입니다. 일곱째, 비유적으로 포도나무의 '가지'.

H2425.d: חָיָה 283 vb. live; Qal 203; live; be quickened, revive; Pi; preserve alive, let live; give life; quicken, revive, refresh; Hiph; preserve alive, let live; quicken, revive
H2425.sd: to live; causatively to revive — live, save life

H3372.d: יָרֵא vb. fear; Qal; fear, be afraid; stand in awe of; fear, reverence, honour; Niph; be fearful, dreadful; cause astonishment and awe; inspire reverence, godly fear, and awe; Piel. make afraid, terrify
H3372.sd: to fear; morally to revere; causatively to frighten — affright, be (make) afraid, dread(-ful), (put in) fear(-ful, -fully, -ing), (be had in) reverence(-end), × see, terrible (act, -ness, thing)
H3372.kd: יָרֵא — 동사, 약 328회. '두려워하다'. 칼형은 (1) 무서워하다, (2) 경외하다, (3) 공경하여 높이다. 니팔형은 '두려운 것이 되다, 놀라움과 경외를 자아내다'. 피엘형은 '두렵게 하다, 놀라게 하다'. '여호와를 경외하다'라는 표현에서 이 말은 겁내는 것이 아니라 마땅한 두려움으로 높이는 태도를 뜻합니다.

H0430.d: אֱלֹהִים 2570 n.m.pl; pl. in number; rulers, judges, either as divine representatives at sacred places or as reflecting divine majesty and power; divine ones, superhuman beings including God and angels; angels; gods; pl. intensive; god or goddess; godlike one; works of God, or things belongng to him; God; הָאֱלֹהִים the (true) God; אֱלֹהִים = God
H0430.sd: gods in the ordinary sense; but specifically used (in the plural thus, especially with the article) of the supreme God; occasionally applied by way of deference to magistrates; and sometimes as a superlative — angels, × exceeding, God (gods) (-dess, -ly), × (very) great, judges, × mighty
H0430.kd: אֱלֹהִים — 남성 복수형 명사, 약 2,570회. 첫째, 수적인 복수로서 (1) 거룩한 곳에서 하나님을 대리하거나 그 위엄과 권세를 반영하는 통치자·재판장, (2) 하나님과 천사를 아우르는 초자연적 존재들, (3) 천사들, (4) 이방의 신들. 둘째, 강조의 복수로서 (1) 신 또는 여신, (2) 신적인 존재, (3) 하나님의 일이나 그에게 속한 것, (4) 하나님. 정관사가 붙은 הָאֱלֹהִים은 '참 하나님'을 가리킵니다. 형태는 복수지만 이스라엘의 하나님을 가리킬 때는 단수 동사를 취합니다.

H6213a.d: עָשָׂה 2622 vb. do, make; Qal 2524; do (1560 t.); deal with; oft. in phr. do kindness with; abs. act, act with effect; make (670 t.); produce, yield; prepare, esp. of dressing and cooking food; make offering; attend to, put in order; observe, celebrate, religious festival; acquire property of various kinds; appoint priests; bring about of י׳’s effecting a deliverance; use; spend, pass, days of life; Niph. 97; be done; be made, of concr. things; be produced from vine; be prepared, of food; be offered; be observed, passover; be used; Pu. I was made
H6213a.sd: to do or make, in the broadest sense and widest application — accomplish, advance, appoint, apt, be at, become, bear, bestow, bring forth, bruise, be busy, × certainly, have the charge of, commit, deal (with), deck, displease, do, (ready) dress(-ed), (put in) execute(-ion), exercise, fashion, feast, (fight-) ing man, finish, fit, fly, follow, fulfill, furnish, gather, get, go about, govern, grant, great, hinder, hold (a feast), × indeed, be industrious, journey, keep, labour, maintain, make, be meet, observe, be occupied, offer, officer, pare, bring (come) to pass, perform, pracise, prepare, procure, provide, put, requite, × sacrifice, serve, set, shew, × sin, spend, × surely, take, × thoroughly, trim, × very, vex, be (warr-) ior, work(-man), yield, use
H6213a.kd: עָשָׂה — 동사, 약 2,622회. '하다, 만들다'. 칼형(2,524회)에서 (1) 행하다(약 1,560회), 대하다(특히 '~에게 인애를 베풀다'라는 어구), 효력 있게 행동하다. (2) 만들다(약 670회), 산출하다, 열매 맺다. (3) 음식을 마련하고 요리하다, 제물을 드리다, 정돈하다, 절기를 지키다. (4) 재산을 얻다, 제사장을 세우다, 여호와께서 구원을 이루시다, 사용하다, 세월을 보내다. 니팔형(97회)은 '행해지다, 만들어지다, 준비되다, 드려지다, 지켜지다'. 푸알형은 '만들어졌다'.

H1696.d: [דָבַר] 1142 vb. speak (original mng. dub.); Qal speak; Niph. reciprocal sense, speak with one another, talk; Pi. speak; Pu. in the day when she may be spoken for; Hithp. speaking this word; Hiph. either leads subject, or puts to flight, fig. for subdues
H1696.sd: perhaps properly, to arrange; but used figuratively (of words), to speak; rarely (in a destructive sense) to subdue — answer, appoint, bid, command, commune, declare, destroy, give, name, promise, pronounce, rehearse, say, speak, be spokesman, subdue, talk, teach, tell, think, use (entreaties), utter, × well, × work
H1696.kd: דָבַר — 동사, 약 1,142회. '말하다'. 본래 뜻은 분명하지 않습니다. 칼형 '말하다', 니팔형은 상호적 의미로 '서로 이야기하다', 피엘형이 가장 흔하게 '말하다'로 쓰입니다. 푸알형은 '(어떤 이를 두고) 말해지다'. 히트파엘형은 '이 말을 하다'. 히필형은 드물게 쓰여 '이끌다' 또는 '몰아내다'는 뜻인데, 비유적으로 '굴복시키다'가 됩니다. 스트롱은 본디 '차례로 놓다, 정돈하다'가 어원일 것으로 보며, 여기서 말을 가지런히 늘어놓는다는 뜻이 나왔다고 풀이합니다. 문맥에 따라 명하다·약속하다·선언하다·가르치다로도 옮깁니다.

H2421.d: חָיָה 283 vb. live; Qal 203; live; be quickened, revive; Pi; preserve alive, let live; give life; quicken, revive, refresh; Hiph; preserve alive, let live; quicken, revive
H2421.sd: to live, whether literally or figuratively; causatively, to revive — keep (leave, make) alive, × certainly, give (promise) life, (let, suffer to) live, nourish up, preserve (alive), quicken, recover, repair, restore (to life), revive, (× God) save (alive, life, lives), × surely, be whole

H3206.d: יֶ֫לֶד 89 n.m. child, son, boy, youth
H3206.sd: something born, i.e. a lad or offspring — boy, child, fruit, son, young man (one)

H7121.d: קָרָא 724 vb. call, proclaim, read; Qal; call, cry, utter a loud sound; call, cry; call unto some one; cry for help; proclaim; read aloud; read to oneself; summon; call = name; Niph; reflex; pass. be called; Pu. be called
H7121.sd: to call out to (i.e. properly, address by name, but used in a wide variety of applications) — bewray (self), that are bidden, call (for, forth, self, upon), cry (unto), (be) famous, guest, invite, mention, (give) name, preach, (make) proclaim(-ation), pronounce, publish, read, renowned, say
H7121.kd: קָרָא — 동사, 약 724회. '부르다, 외치다, 읽다'. 칼형에서 (1) 큰 소리를 내다, 외치다, (2) 누구를 향하여 부르다, (3) 도움을 구하여 부르짖다, (4) 선포하다, (5) 소리 내어 읽다, (6) 혼자 읽다, (7) 불러 모으다, (8) 이름을 지어 부르다. 니팔형은 재귀적 용법과 함께 수동으로 '~라 불리다'. 푸알형도 '불리다'. 이름을 부르는 데서 초청하다·선포하다·전파하다까지 넓게 쓰입니다.

H4069.sd: what (is) known?; i.e. (by implication) (adverbially) why? — how, wherefore, why

H1697.d: דָּבָר 1439 n.m. speech, word; sg. speech, discourse, saying, word, as the sum of that which is spoken; sg. saying, utterance, sentence, as a section of a discourse; sg. a word, words; sg. matter, affair, thing about which one speaks
H1697.sd: a word; by implication, a matter (as spoken of) or thing; adverbially, a cause — act, advice, affair, answer, × any such (thing), because of, book, business, care, case, cause, certain rate, chronicles, commandment, × commune(-ication), concern(-ing), confer, counsel, dearth, decree, deed, × disease, due, duty, effect, eloquent, errand, (evil favoured-) ness, glory, harm, hurt, iniquity, judgment, language, lying, manner, matter, message, (no) thing, oracle, × ought, × parts, pertaining, please, portion, power, promise, provision, purpose, question, rate, reason, report, request, × (as hast) said, sake, saying, sentence, sign, so, some (uncleanness), somewhat to say, song, speech, × spoken, talk, task, that, × there done, thing (concerning), thought, thus, tidings, what(-soever), wherewith, which, word, work
H1697.kd: דָּבָר — 남성명사, 약 1,439회. '말, 말씀'. 첫째, 말해진 것 전체로서의 말, 담화, 이야기. 둘째, 담화의 한 대목으로서의 한 마디, 문장. 셋째, 낱말, 말들. 넷째, 사람이 말하는 대상 곧 '일, 사건, 사안'. 히브리어에서 '말'과 '일'이 한 낱말이라는 점이 중요합니다. 스트롱도 '말'에서 함의상 '말해지는 사안이나 사물'로, 부사적으로는 '까닭'으로 확장된다고 봅니다.

H2088.d: זֶה demonstr.pron. and adv.; fem. זֹאת, once זֹאתָה; this, here; standing alone; In appos. to subst; More oft. as pred; It is attached enclitically, almost as an adv., to certain words, esp. interrog. pronouns, to impart, in a manner often not reproducible in Engl. idiom, directness and force, bringing the question or statement made into close relation with the speaker; In poetry, as a relative pron. (rare); With prefixes (in special senses)
H2088.sd: the masculine demonstrative pronoun, this or that — he, × hence, × here, it(-self), × now, × of him, the one...the other, × than the other, (× out of) the (self) same, such (a one) that, these, this (hath, man), on this side...on that side, × thus, very, which. Compare 2063, 2090, 2097, 2098
H2088.kd: זֶה — 지시대명사이자 지시부사. 여성형은 זֹאת입니다. '이, 이것, 여기'. 첫째, 홀로 서서 '이것'을 가리킵니다. 둘째, 명사에 동격으로 붙어 '이 사람, 이 일'이 됩니다. 셋째, 더 자주는 서술어 자리에 놓여 '이것은 ~이다'가 됩니다. 넷째, 특히 의문사 뒤에 붙어 거의 부사처럼 쓰이는데, 물음이나 진술을 말하는 이와 바짝 붙여 놓아 직접성과 힘을 더합니다(우리말로 옮기기 어려운 어감으로, '대체, 도대체' 정도에 해당합니다). 다섯째, 시문에서는 드물게 관계대명사로 쓰입니다. 전치사가 붙으면 '이로써, 이 때문에, 여기에' 등 특수한 뜻을 냅니다.

H0802.d: אִשָּׁה 773 n.f. woman, wife, female; woman; Wife (woman belonging to a man, usually cstr. or sf.); Female of animals; With distrib. & recipr. sense, each woman from her neighbor; each one
H0802.sd: a woman — (adulter) ess, each, every, female, × many, none, one, together, wife, woman. Often unexpressed in English
H0802.kd: אִשָּׁה — 여성명사, 약 773회. '여자'. 첫째, 여자 일반. 둘째, 아내(남자에게 속한 여자라는 뜻으로 대개 연계형이나 접미사와 함께 쓰입니다). 셋째, 짐승의 암컷. 넷째, 배분과 상호의 뜻으로 짝을 이루어 쓰이면 '여자마다 그 이웃에게서' 곧 '저마다'가 됩니다.

H2422.d: [חָיֶה] adj. having the vigour of life, lively—fpl. (E)

H2007.sd: themselves (often used emphatic for the copula, also in indirect relation) — × in, × such (and such things), their, (into) them, thence, therein, these, they (had), on this side, whose, wherein

H2962.d: טֶ֫רֶם 54, once ( Kt) טְרוֹם, adv. of time not yet, ere, before that
H2962.sd: properly, non-occurrence; used adverbially, not yet or before — before, ere, not yet

H3190.d: [יָטַב] vb. be good, well, glad, pleasing; Qal; be glad, joyful; be well placed; impers. be well for or with, go well with; be pleasing; Hithp; make glad, rejoice; do good to, deal well with; do well or thoroughly; make a thing good, right, beautiful; do well, right, ethically
H3190.sd: to be (causative) make well, literally (sound, beautiful) or figuratively (happy, successful, right) — be accepted, amend, use aright, benefit, be (make) better, seem best, make cheerful, be comely, be content, diligent(-ly), dress, earnestly, find favour, give, be glad, do (be, make) good(-ness), be (make) merry, please ( well), shew more (kindness), skilfully, × very small, surely, make sweet, thoroughly, tire, trim, very, be (can, deal, entreat, go, have) well (said, seen)

H6680.d: [צָוָה] 485 vb. Pi. lay charge (upon), give charge (to), charge, command, order
H6680.sd: (intensively) to constitute, enjoin — appoint, (for-) bid, (give a) charge, (give a, give in, send with) command(-er, -ment), send a messenger, put, (set) in order
H6680.kd: צָוָה — 동사, 약 485회. 피엘형으로만 쓰여 '명하다, 분부하다, 맡기다'. 누구에게 책임이나 임무를 지우는 것이 기본 뜻이고, 여기서 '임명하다, 지시하다, 유언으로 당부하다'라는 뜻도 나옵니다. '여호와께서 모세에게 명하신 대로'라는 어구가 특히 자주 나옵니다.

H2975.d: יְאֹר, יְאוֹר n.m. stream of the Nile, stream, canal
H2975.sd: a channel, e.g. a fosse, canal, shaft; specifically the Nile, as the one river of Egypt, including its collateral trenches; also the Tigris, as the main river of Assyria — brook, flood, river, stream

H7993.d: [שָׁלַךְ] 125 vb. Hiph. 112 throw, fling, cast; Hoph; be thrown, cast; be cast forth, out; be cast down; metaph., be cast
H7993.sd: to throw out, down or away (literally or figuratively) — adventure, cast (away, down, forth, off, out), hurl, pluck, throw

H3212.d: הָלַךְ 1546 vb. go, come, walk; Qal Impf. usually (629 t.) as if from ילך; lit; of persons; Also of animals, in similar meanings and combinations; in like manner of inanimate things; The inf. abs. is often used; as in other vbs., quite independently; to intensify meaning of finite form; most noteworthy is the joining of the Inf. abs; with a following Inf. abs. denoting a simutaneous action or process, and so emphasizing duration or continuance; with a foll. vb. fin. c. ו consec. (rare); in cases where vb. fin. is foll. by Inf. abs. adj. denoting progress, advance; twice, where vb. fin. is not הלך, but another vb. denoting motion; quite by itself; 13 t. the Inf. abs. = Imv. & is followed by Pf. consec; akin to the use of Inf. abs. are some instances of Pt; In combination with other verbal forms; Fig.; the most common uses follow; in most the origin in a literal meaning is evident: pass away, die; live (‘walk’), in general; of moral and religious life; other fig. uses; Pi. (chiefly poet. and late); walk in or with a throng; also of walking about = living; depart, go entirely away; fig. of mode of life, action, etc; Hithp. walk, walk about, move to and fro; Hiph; lead, bring; lead away; carry, bring; fig. of influence on character; cause to walk, go; cause to flow, run; cause to depart, retire, go back
H3212.sd: to walk (literally or figuratively); causatively, to carry (in various senses) — × again, away, bear, bring, carry (away), come (away), depart, flow, follow(-ing), get (away, hence, him), (cause to, made) go (away, -ing, -ne, one's way, out), grow, lead (forth), let down, march, prosper, pursue, cause to run, spread, take away (-journey), vanish, (cause to) walk(-ing), wax, × be weak
H3212.kd: יָלַךְ / הָלַךְ — 동사, 약 1,546회. '가다, 오다, 걷다'. 칼형 미완료는 대개 ילך 어근에서 온 형태를 씁니다. 사람에게도 짐승에게도 무생물에게도 두루 쓰이며, 부정사 절대형이 다른 동사와 겹쳐 놓여 동작이 계속되거나 점점 더해 감을 나타내는 용법이 특징적입니다(예: '가고 또 가서', '점점 더'). 비유적으로는 (1) 지나가다, 죽다, (2) 일반적으로 '살아가다', (3) 특히 도덕적·종교적 삶의 태도를 두고 '행하다, 걷다'로 쓰입니다. 피엘형은 주로 시문과 후기 문헌에서 '거닐다, 살아가다, 아주 떠나가다'. 히트파엘형은 '이리저리 다니다'. 히필형은 '이끌다, 데려가다, 데리고 가 버리다, 흐르게 하다, 물러가게 하다'.

H3947.d: לָקַח 965 vb. take; Qal; take, take in hand; take and carry along with oneself; take from, or out of; take, carry away; take away from, so as to deprive of; esp. take away life; take to or for a person; take up, upon = put upon; = fetch; take = lead, conduct (with or without contact); take = capture, seize; take = carry off; in phr. take vengeance; Niph; be captured, of ark; be taken away, removed; be taken, brought unto; Pu; be taken from, out of; = be stolen from; be taken captive; be taken away, removed; Hoph; be taken, brought unto; be taken out of; be taken away from; Hithp. lit. fire taking hold of itself, of lightning
H3947.sd: to take (in the widest variety of applications) — accept, bring, buy, carry away, drawn, fetch, get, infold, × many, mingle, place, receive(-ing), reserve, seize, send for, take (away, -ing, up), use, win
H3947.kd: לָקַח — 동사, 약 965회. '취하다, 잡다'. 칼형에서 손에 쥐다, 가지고 가다, ~에게서 꺼내다, 앗아 가다, 빼앗아 없게 하다(특히 목숨을 앗다), 누구를 위하여 취하다, 위에 얹다, 가져오다, 이끌다, 사로잡다, 노략하다로 쓰이며, '원수를 갚다'라는 관용구에도 들어갑니다. 니팔형은 '사로잡히다, 옮겨지다, ~에게로 데려가지다'. 푸알형은 '~에서 취해지다, 도둑맞다, 사로잡히다, 치워지다'. 호팔형도 비슷합니다. 히트파엘형은 번개를 두고 '불이 서로 엉키다'로 쓰입니다. 문맥에 따라 받다·사다·데려오다·맞이하다로 옮깁니다.

H2029.d: הָרָה vb. conceive, become pregnant; Qal; lit. conceive, become pregnant; metaph; Pu. a man hath been conceived; Po. conceive, contrive, devise
H2029.sd: to be (or become) pregnant, conceive (literally or figuratively) — been, be with child, conceive, progenitor

H2896a.d: טוֹב adj. pleasant, agreeable, good; pleasant, agreeable to the senses; pleasant to the higher nature, giving pleasure, happiness, prosperity, and so agreeable, pleasing, well; good, excellent, of its kind; good, rich, valuable in estimation; good, appropriate, becoming; c. מִן compar. = better; of man's sensuous nature, glad, happy, prosperous; of man's intellectual nature, good understanding; good, kind, benign; good (ethical), right
H2896a.sd: good (as an adjective) in the widest sense; used likewise as a noun, both in the masculine and the feminine, the singular and the plural (good, a good or good thing, a good man or woman; the good, goods or good things, good men or women), also as an adverb (well) — beautiful, best, better, bountiful, cheerful, at ease, × fair (word), (be in) favour, fine, glad, good (deed, -lier, -liest, -ly, -ness, -s), graciously, joyful, kindly, kindness, liketh (best), loving, merry, × most, pleasant, pleaseth, pleasure, precious, prosperity, ready, sweet, wealth, welfare, (be) well(-favoured)
H2896a.kd: טוֹב — 형용사, 약 410회. '좋은'. 첫째, 감각에 좋은 것 곧 아름답고 맛있고 향기로운 것. 둘째, 사람의 높은 본성에 좋은 것 곧 기쁨과 행복과 형통을 주는 것. 셋째, 그 종류에서 뛰어난 것. 넷째, 값지고 귀한 것. 다섯째, 알맞고 마땅한 것. 비교의 מִן과 함께 쓰면 '~보다 나은'. 여섯째, 사람의 감정에 대해 '기쁜, 즐거운, 형통한'. 일곱째, 지성에 대해 '명철한'. 여덟째, '인자한, 자애로운'. 아홉째, 윤리적으로 '선한, 옳은'. 명사로 쓰이면 '좋은 것, 복, 선', 부사로 쓰이면 '잘'이 됩니다.

H6845.d: צָפַן vb. hide, treasure up; Qal; trans. hide; intrans. lie hid, lurk; Niph. be hidden from before; Hiph. hide
H6845.sd: to hide (by covering over); by implication, to hoard or reserve; figuratively to deny; specifically (favorably) to protect, (unfavorably) to lurk — esteem, hide(-den one, self), lay up, lurk (be set) privily, (keep) secret(-ly, place)

H7969.d: שָׁלֹשׁ, שָׁלוֹשׁ, שְׁלֹשָׁה 430 n.m. et f. a three, triad
H7969.sd: three; occasionally (ordinal) third, or (multiple) thrice — fork, often(-times), third, thir(-teen, -teenth), three, thrice. Compare 7991
H7969.kd: שָׁלֹשׁ (남성형 שְׁלֹשָׁה) — 수사, 약 430회. '셋'. 서수로 '셋째', 배수로 '세 번'을 뜻하기도 하고, 다른 수와 합해져 '열셋'을 이룹니다.

H3391.sd: a lunation, i.e. month — month, moon

H3201.d: יָכֹל, יָכוֹל 193 vb. be able, have power, prevail, endure; Qal; be able, to do a thing,, whether ability be physical, moral, constitutional, or dependent on external authority; prevail; abs. have ability, strength, only neg
H3201.sd: to be able, literally (can, could) or morally (may, might) — be able, any at all (ways), attain, can (away with, (-not)), could, endure, might, overcome, have power, prevail, still, suffer

H5750.d: עוֹד and (14 t.) עֹד subst. a going round, continuance, but used mostly as adv. acc. still, yet, again, besides
H5750.sd: properly, iteration or continuance; used only adverbially (with or without preposition), again, repeatedly, still, more — again, × all life long, at all, besides, but, else, further(-more), henceforth, (any) longer, (any) more(-over), × once, since, (be) still, when, (good, the) while (having being), (as, because, whether, while) yet (within)
H5750.kd: עוֹד — 본디 '한 바퀴 돎, 이어짐'을 뜻하는 명사인데, 거의 언제나 부사로 쓰여 '아직, 여전히, 다시, 또한, 게다가'가 됩니다. 부정어와 함께 쓰이면 '더 이상 ~않다'가 됩니다. '그가 아직 살아 있을 때에'처럼 시간의 이어짐을 나타내는 데도 자주 씁니다.

H1573.sd: properly, an absorbent, i.e. the bulrush (from its porosity); specifically the papyrus — (bul-) rush

H2560b.d: [חָמַר] vb. denom. cover or smear with asphalt, only (E)
H2560b.sd: properly, to boil up; hence, to ferment (with scum); to glow (with redness); to smear with pitch — daub, befoul, be red, trouble

H2564.sd: bitumen (as rising to the surface) — slime(-pit)

H2203.sd: asphalt (from its tendency to soften in the sun) — pitch

H5488.d: סוּף n.m. reeds, rushes; rushes, in Nile; Red Sea
H5488.sd: a reed, especially the papyrus — flag, Red (sea), weed. Compare 5489

H8193.d: שָׂפָה 176 n.f. lip, speech, edge; lip; language; edge: shore of sea; bank of river
H8193.sd: the lip (as a natural boundary); by implication, language; by analogy, a margin (of a vessel, water, cloth, etc.) — band, bank, binding, border, brim, brink, edge, language, lip, prating, (sea-)shore, side, speech, talk, (vain) words

H3320.d: [יָצַב] vb. only Hithp. set or station oneself, take one's stand
H3320.sd: to place (any thing so as to stay); reflexively, to station, offer, continue — present selves, remaining, resort, set (selves), (be able to, can, with-) stand (fast, forth, -ing, still, up)

H0269.d: אָחוֹת 114 n.f. sister; sister; = beloved; symbol. of Judah, Samaria, Sodom & Jerusalem; fig. of intimate connection; another
H0269.sd: a sister (used very widely [like 251], literally and figuratively) — (an-) other, sister, together

H7350.d: רָחֹק, רָחוֹק adj. distant, far, et n.m. distance
H7350.sd: remote, literally or figuratively, of place or time; specifically, precious; often used adverbially (with preposition) — (a-) far (abroad, off), long ago, of old, space, great while to come

H4100.d: מָה, rarely מָה־, מַה־, מַה‍ּ, מֶה, מַ‍ּ, מָ—pron.interrog. and indef. what? how? aught; interrog. what?; Used adverbially; Indef. pron; With preps
H4100.sd: properly, interrogative what? (including how? why? when?); but also exclamation, what! (including how!), or indefinitely what (including whatever, and even relatively, that which); often used with prefixes in various adverbial or conjunctive senses — how (long, oft, (-soever)), (no-) thing, what (end, good, purpose, thing), whereby(-fore, -in, -to, -with), (for) why
H4100.kd: מָה — 의문대명사이자 부정대명사. 첫째, 의문사로 '무엇?'. 둘째, 부사처럼 쓰여 '어찌하여? 얼마나?'. 셋째, 부정대명사로 '무엇이든, 아무것'. 넷째, 감탄으로 '얼마나 ~한가!'. 다섯째, 관계적으로 '~하는 것'. 전치사가 붙으면 '어찌하여, 무엇으로, 무엇에, 언제까지' 등 여러 부사·접속사 표현을 이룹니다.

H3381.d: יָרַד 380 vb. come or go down, descend; Qal 306; come or go down; go down (usu. from mountain or hill-country into plain), to battle; go down to (acc.) threshing-floor; go down (abs.) from Palestine to Egypt; from Jerusalem; from altar; go down; = sink, in water; go down to She’ôl; fig. going down (dissolving) in tears; = be prostrated; of divine manifestations: descend; of inanimate things; Hiph; cause to come or go down; bring down; send down rain = cause to flow down; = lay prostrate to (acc.) threshing-floor; bring down to She’ôl; take down (from cart); let down; Hoph; be brought down; be taken down
H3381.sd: to descend (literally, to go downwards; or conventionally to a lower region, as the shore, a boundary, the enemy, etc.; or figuratively, to fall); causatively, to bring down (in all the above applications) — × abundantly, bring down, carry down, cast down, (cause to) come(-ing) down, fall (down), get down, go(-ing) down(-ward), hang down, × indeed, let down, light (down), put down (off), (cause to, let) run down, sink, subdue, take down
H3381.kd: יָרַד — 동사, 약 380회. '내려가다'. 칼형이 306회로, 산지에서 평지로 내려가 싸우다, 타작마당으로 내려가다, 팔레스타인에서 애굽으로 내려가다, 예루살렘에서 내려가다, 제단에서 내려오다, 물에 가라앉다, 스올로 내려가다, 비유적으로 눈물에 잠기다, 엎드러지다로 쓰이며, 하나님이 나타나실 때 '강림하시다'도 이 말입니다. 히필형은 '내려가게 하다, 내려놓다, 비를 내리다, 스올로 내려보내다, 수레에서 내리다, 늘어뜨리다'. 호팔형은 '내려지다'. 예루살렘이 높은 곳에 있어 어디로 가든 '올라가고' 떠나면 '내려가는' 표현이 굳어졌습니다.

H7364.d: רָחַץ 72 vb. wash, wash off, away, bathe; Qal 69; trans. wash (with water); intrans. wash, bathe (oneself); Pu. be washed; Hithp. if I washed myself in snow
H7364.sd: to lave (the whole or a part of a thing) — bathe (self), wash (self)
