H5291.d: נַעֲרָה n.f. girl, damsel; girl, damsel; of female attendants, maids
H5291.sd: a girl (from infancy to adolescence) — damsel, maid(-en), young (woman)

H1980.d: הָלַךְ 1546 vb. go, come, walk; Qal Impf. usually (629 t.) as if from ילך; lit; of persons; Also of animals, in similar meanings and combinations; in like manner of inanimate things; The inf. abs. is often used; as in other vbs., quite independently; to intensify meaning of finite form; most noteworthy is the joining of the Inf. abs; with a following Inf. abs. denoting a simutaneous action or process, and so emphasizing duration or continuance; with a foll. vb. fin. c. ו consec. (rare); in cases where vb. fin. is foll. by Inf. abs. adj. denoting progress, advance; twice, where vb. fin. is not הלך, but another vb. denoting motion; quite by itself; 13 t. the Inf. abs. = Imv. & is followed by Pf. consec; akin to the use of Inf. abs. are some instances of Pt; In combination with other verbal forms; Fig.; the most common uses follow; in most the origin in a literal meaning is evident: pass away, die; live (‘walk’), in general; of moral and religious life; other fig. uses; Pi. (chiefly poet. and late); walk in or with a throng; also of walking about = living; depart, go entirely away; fig. of mode of life, action, etc; Hithp. walk, walk about, move to and fro; Hiph; lead, bring; lead away; carry, bring; fig. of influence on character; cause to walk, go; cause to flow, run; cause to depart, retire, go back
H1980.sd: to walk (in a great variety of applications, literally and figuratively) — (all) along, apace, behave (self), come, (on) continually, be conversant, depart, be eased, enter, exercise (self), follow, forth, forward, get, go (about, abroad, along, away, forward, on, out, up and down), greater, grow, be wont to haunt, lead, march, × more and more, move (self), needs, on, pass (away), be at the point, quite, run (along), send, speedily, spread, still, surely, tale-bearer, travel(-ler), walk (abroad, on, to and fro, up and down, to places), wander, wax, (way-) faring man, × be weak, whirl
H1980.kd: הָלַךְ — 동사, 약 1,546회. '가다, 오다, 걷다'. 사람에게도 짐승에게도 무생물에게도 두루 쓰입니다. 부정사 절대형을 겹쳐 놓아 동작이 이어지거나 점점 더해 감을 나타내는 용법이 두드러집니다(예: '가며 자라며' 곧 '점점 더'). 비유적으로는 (1) 지나가다, 죽다, (2) 일반적으로 '살아가다', (3) 특히 도덕적·종교적 삶의 태도를 두고 '행하다'로 쓰여, '여호와 앞에서 행하다'와 같은 표현을 이룹니다. 피엘형은 주로 시문과 후기 문헌에서 '거닐다, 살아가다, 아주 떠나다'. 히트파엘형은 '이리저리 다니다'. 히필형은 '이끌다, 데려가다, 흐르게 하다, 물러가게 하다'. 같은 뜻의 יָלַךְ(H3212)와 짝을 이루어 한 동사의 활용을 나눠 맡습니다.

H3027.d: יָד 1604 n.f. hand; hand; Fig. = strength, power; Fig. = side; יָד is used in various special, technical senses:—; sign, monument; part, fractional part or share; time, repetition; axle-trees; stays, supports for laver; tenons on sides of boards of tabernacle; a (beckoning) hand; יַד with prep
H3027.sd: a hand (the open one [indicating power, means, direction, etc.], in distinction from 3709, the closed one); used (as noun, adverb, etc.) in a great variety of applications, both literally and figuratively, both proximate and remote [as follows] — ( be) able, × about, armholes, at, axletree, because of, beside, border, × bounty, broad, (broken-) handed, × by, charge, coast, consecrate, creditor, custody, debt, dominion, × enough, fellowship, force, × from, hand(-staves, -y work), × he, himself, × in, labour, large, ledge, (left-) handed, means, × mine, ministry, near, × of, × order, ordinance, × our, parts, pain, power, × presumptuously, service, side, sore, state, stay, draw with strength, stroke, swear, terror, × thee, × by them, × themselves, × thine own, × thou, through, × throwing, thumb, times, × to, × under, × us, × wait on, (way-) side, where, wide, × with (him, me, you), work, yield, × yourselves
H3027.kd: יָד — 여성명사, 약 1,604회. '손'. 첫째, 손. 둘째, 비유적으로 힘, 권능. 셋째, 비유적으로 '쪽, 편'. 넷째, 여러 전문적인 뜻으로 표(標)나 기념비, 몫이나 분깃, 횟수·배수, 수레의 굴대, 물두멍의 받침대, 성막 널판의 촉, 부르는 손짓 등을 가리킵니다. 여러 전치사와 결합해 '~의 손에, ~를 통하여, ~곁에'라는 표현을 이룹니다. 스트롱은 주먹을 뜻하는 3709와 달리 펼친 손을 가리키며 권능·수단·방향을 함의한다고 설명합니다.

H8432.sd: a bisection, i.e. (by implication) the centre — among(-st), × between, half, × (there-, where-), in(-to), middle, mid(-night), midst (among), × out (of), × through, × with(-in)
H8432.kd: תָּ֫וֶךְ — 명사, 약 416회. '가운데'. 반으로 나눈 그 가운데를 뜻하며, 거의 언제나 전치사와 함께 '~한가운데, ~안에, ~사이에, ~로부터'라는 어구를 이룹니다.

H7971.d: שָׁלַח 814 vb. send; Qal; send: human subj; send: subj. י׳ (God); stretch out, esp. acc. hand; rarely send away: human subj; let loose; Niph. letters were sent; Pi; send off, away, human subj; send away, subj. י׳; give over; cast out; send out, forth; let go, set free; shoot forth branches; let down; shoot; Phrases; Pu. be sent off (started on journey); be put away, divorced, of wife; be impelled(?); Hiph. and I (י׳) will send
H7971.sd: to send away, for, or out (in a great variety of applications) — × any wise, appoint, bring (on the way), cast (away, out), conduct, × earnestly, forsake, give (up), grow long, lay, leave, let depart (down, go, loose), push away, put (away, forth, in, out), reach forth, send (away, forth, out), set, shoot (forth, out), sow, spread, stretch forth (out)
H7971.kd: שָׁלַח — 동사, 약 814회. '보내다'. 칼형에서 사람이 보내는 경우와 하나님이 보내시는 경우가 있고, 특히 손을 '내밀다'는 뜻으로 자주 쓰입니다. 드물게 '내보내다, 놓아주다'로도 씁니다. 니팔형은 '편지가 보내지다'. 피엘형은 '떠나보내다, 내치다, 내쫓다, 내보내다, 풀어 주다, 가지를 뻗다, 내려보내다, 쏘다'. 푸알형은 '보내어지다', 아내에 대해서는 '내보내지다' 곧 이혼당하다. 히필형은 '내가 보내리라'와 같이 쓰입니다.

H0519.d: אָמָה n.f. maid, handmaid; lit. maidservant; fig. in address
H0519.sd: a maid-servant or female slave — (hand-) bondmaid(-woman), maid(-servant)

H6605a.d: פָּתַח vb. open; Qal open sack; Niph. be opened; Pi. be opened; free, i.e. ungird, camels; loosen (and remove) sack-cloth; open gates, doors; Hithp. loosen thee the fetters of thy neck
H6605a.sd: to open wide (literally or figuratively); specifically, to loosen, begin, plough, carve — appear, break forth, draw (out), let go free, (en-) grave(-n), loose (self), (be, be set) open(-ing), put off, ungird, unstop, have vent

H5288.d: נַ֫עַר 239 n.m. 1. boy, lad, youth. 2. retainer (not in P); boy, lad, youth (c. 133 t.); servant, retainer (c. 105 t.)
H5288.sd: (concretely) a boy (as active), from the age of infancy to adolescence; by implication, a servant; also (by interch. of sex), a girl (of similar latitude in age) — babe, boy, child, damsel (from the margin), lad, servant, young (man)

H1058.d: בָּכָה 114 vb. weep, bewail; Qal; weep; weep bitterly; weep upon; bewail; in sense of burden, annoy with weeping; of penitent weeping; Pi. lament; bewail
H1058.sd: to weep; generally to bemoan — × at all, bewail, complain, make lamentation, × more, mourn, × sore, × with tears, weep

H2550.sd: to commiserate; by implication, to spare — have compassion, (have) pity, spare

H3243.d: [יָנַק] vb. suck; Qal suck, of infant at mother's breast; Hiph. give suck to, nurse
H3243.sd: to suck; causatively, to give milk — milch, nurse(-ing mother), (give, make to) suck(-ing child, -ling)

H5959.d: עַלְמָה n.f. young woman (ripe sexually; maid or newly married)
H5959.sd: a lass (as veiled or private) — damsel, maid, virgin

H0517.d: אֵם 221 n.f. mother; lit. (human) mother; fig. of Deborah as caring for her people; of animals, dam; = point of departure or division
H0517.sd: a mother (as the bond of the family); in a wide sense (both literally and figuratively [like father]) — dam, mother, × parting

H0589.sd: I, (as for) me, mine, myself, we, × which, × who
H0589.kd: אֲנִי — 일인칭 단수 대명사, 약 874회. '나'. 히브리어 동사는 인칭을 어미로 나타내므로 이 대명사는 대개 강조를 위해 덧붙습니다. '나는 여호와니라'처럼 주어를 힘주어 내세울 때 특히 두드러집니다.

H5414.d: נָתַן 2007 vb. give, put, set; Qal 1917; give; Put, set; Make, constitute; Niph. 82; be given; Be put, set; Hoph; be given, bestowed; = be given to one for wife; be put upon
H5414.sd: to give, used with greatest latitude of application (put, make, etc.) — add, apply, appoint, ascribe, assign, × avenge, × be (healed), bestow, bring (forth, hither), cast, cause, charge, come, commit, consider, count, cry, deliver (up), direct, distribute, do, × doubtless, × without fail, fasten, frame, × get, give (forth, over, up), grant, hang (up), × have, × indeed, lay (unto charge, up), (give) leave, lend, let (out), lie, lift up, make, O that, occupy, offer, ordain, pay, perform, place, pour, print, × pull, put (forth), recompense, render, requite, restore, send (out), set (forth), shew, shoot forth (up), sing, slander, strike, (sub-) mit, suffer, × surely, × take, thrust, trade, turn, utter, weep, willingly, withdraw, would (to) God, yield
H5414.kd: נָתַן — 동사, 약 2,007회. '주다, 두다, 놓다'. 칼형(1,917회)에서 (1) 주다, (2) 놓다, 두다, (3) 삼다, 세우다. 니팔형(82회)은 '주어지다, 놓이다, 세워지다'. 호팔형은 '주어지다, 베풀어지다'이며 '아내로 주어지다', '~위에 놓이다'로도 쓰입니다. 적용 범위가 매우 넓어 문맥에 따라 맡기다·허락하다·내주다·베풀다·내다·이루다 등으로 옮겨집니다.

H7939.d: שָׂכָר n.m. hire, wages; wages, of a servant; = reward, for work done, faithfulness, etc; passage-money, fare
H7939.sd: payment of contract; concretely, salary, fare, maintenance; by implication, compensation, benefit — hire, price, reward(-ed), wages, worth

H5134.d: [נוּק] vb. whence might come, Hiph. suckle, nurse;—

H1431.d: גָּדַל 115 vb. grow up, become great; Qal; grow up; become great; to be magnified; Pi; cause to grow; make great, powerful; magnify; Pu. brought up; Hiph; make great; magnify; do great things; Hithp. I will magnify myself
H1431.sd: to be (causatively make) large (in various senses, as in body, mind, estate or honor, also in pride) — advance, boast, bring up, exceed, excellent, be(-come, do, give, make, wax), great(-er, come to... estate, things), grow(up), increase, lift up, magnify(-ifical), be much set by, nourish (up), pass, promote, proudly (spoken), tower

H4872.d: מֹשֶׁה 767 n.pr.m. Moses, the great Hebrew leader, prophet and lawgiver
H4872.kd: מֹשֶׁה — 남성 고유명사, 약 767회. 모세. 이스라엘을 애굽에서 이끌어 낸 지도자이자 선지자이며 율법을 전한 사람입니다.

H4325.d: [מַי] 580 n.m. only pl. מַ֫יִם waters, water
H4325.sd: water; figuratively, juice; by euphemism, urine, semen — piss, wasting, water(-ing, (-course, -flood, -spring))
H4325.kd: מַ֫יִם — 남성명사, 늘 복수로만 쓰이며 약 580회. '물'. 비유적으로 즙을 가리키기도 하고, 완곡어법으로 오줌이나 정액을 뜻하기도 합니다.

H4871.d: [מָשָׁה] vb. draw; Qal out of the water I drew him; Hiph. fig
H4871.sd: to pull out (literally or figuratively) — draw(out)

H3117.d: יוֹם 2285 n.m. day; day, opp. night; Day as division of time; יוֹם י׳ day of Yahweh, chiefly as time of his coming in judgment, involving often blessedness for righteous; Pl. days of anyone; Days; יוֹם = time; Phrases
H3117.sd: a day (as the warm hours), whether literal (from sunrise to sunset, or from one sunset to the next), or figurative (a space of time defined by an associated term), (often used adverb) — age, always, chronicals, continually(-ance), daily, ((birth-), each, to) day, (now a, two) days (agone), elder, × end, evening, (for) ever(-lasting, -more), × full, life, as (so) long as (... live), (even) now, old, outlived, perpetually, presently, remaineth, × required, season, × since, space, then, (process of) time, as at other times, in trouble, weather, (as) when, (a, the, within a) while (that), × whole ( age), (full) year(-ly), younger
H3117.kd: יוֹם — 남성명사, 약 2,285회. '날'. 첫째, 밤과 대비되는 낮. 둘째, 시간을 나누는 단위로서의 하루. 셋째, '여호와의 날'은 주로 그분이 심판하러 오시는 때를 가리키며, 의인에게는 복이 되는 때이기도 합니다. 넷째, 복수형으로 어떤 이의 '생애, 날들'. 다섯째, 넓게 '때, 시기'. 스트롱은 본래 '따뜻한 시간'에서 나와 해뜸부터 해짐까지, 또는 한 해질녘부터 다음 해질녘까지를 가리키며, 비유적으로 어떤 말과 결합해 한정된 기간을 뜻한다고 봅니다.

H1992.d: הֵ֫מָּה and הֵם (without appreciable distinction in usage, except prob. in so far as the longer or shorter form was better adapted to the rhythm of particular sentences) pron. 3 pl. masc. they
H1992.sd: they (only used when emphatic) — it, like, × (how, so) many (soever, more as) they (be), (the) same, × so, × such, their, them, these, they, those, which, who, whom, withal, ye
H1992.kd: הֵ֫מָּה 또는 הֵם — 삼인칭 남성 복수 대명사, 약 565회. '그들'. 두 형태 사이에 뜻의 차이는 없고, 문장의 가락에 어느 쪽이 어울리는가에 따라 골라 쓴 것으로 보입니다. 동사가 이미 인칭을 나타내므로 이 대명사가 따로 나오면 강조하는 것입니다.

H5221.d: [נָכָה] 501 vb. smite (not in Qal); Niph. and he shall be smitten [struck by weapon in battle] and die; Pu. both be smitten down by the hail; Hiph; lit., smite (with a single, non-fatal, blow), strike; smite repeatedly, beat a man; and they clapped hands (in applause); give a thrust (with fork) into pot; strike roots; rarely smite (in battle) so as (merely) to wound; smite, of sun; Smite fatally; Smite = attack, attack and destroy a company; Of God; smite with a plague, disease, etc; smite = chastise, or send judgment upon; of God’s destroying palaces; Hoph. be smitten
H5221.sd: to strike (lightly or severely, literally or figuratively) — beat, cast forth, clap, give (wounds), × go forward, × indeed, kill, make (slaughter), murderer, punish, slaughter, slay(-er, -ing), smite(-r, -ing), strike, be stricken, (give) stripes, × surely, wound
H5221.kd: נָכָה — 동사, 약 501회. '치다'. 칼형은 쓰이지 않습니다. 니팔형은 '(전장에서 무기에) 맞다'. 푸알형은 '우박에 맞아 쓰러지다'. 히필형이 대부분으로, (1) 한 번 쳐서 상하게 하다, (2) 거듭 때리다, 매질하다, (3) 손뼉을 치다, (4) 갈고리를 냄비에 찔러 넣다, (5) 뿌리를 내리다, (6) 전장에서 쳐서 상하게만 하다, (7) 해가 내리쬐어 치다, (8) 쳐서 죽이다, (9) 쳐들어가 한 무리를 진멸하다, (10) 하나님이 재앙이나 질병으로 치시다, (11) 하나님이 징계하시거나 심판을 내리시다. 호팔형은 '침을 당하다'. 문맥에 따라 '치다, 때리다, 죽이다, 무찌르다'로 옮깁니다.

H6437.d: פָּנָה 135 vb. turn; Qal 117; turn toward; turn from; turn and do a thing; turn, decline; turn toward, approach; turn and look, look; of inanimate things, face; esp. fig. look at, regard; look for = expect; fig. look at = consider; Hiph; turn; make a turn, shew (signs of) turning; Hoph. be ye turned back!
H6437.sd: to turn; by implication, to face, i.e. appear, look, etc — appear, at (even-) tide, behold, cast out, come on, × corner, dawning, empty, go away, lie, look, mark, pass away, prepare, regard, (have) respect (to), (re-) turn (aside, away, back, face, self), × right (early)

H3541.d: כֹּה demonstr.adv. thus, here; of manner, thus; of place, here; of time, hitherto
H3541.sd: properly, like this, i.e. by implication, (of manner) thus (or so); also (of place) here (or hither); or (of time) now — also, here, hitherto, like, on the other side, so (and much), such, on that manner, (on) this (manner, side, way, way and that way), mean while, yonder
H3541.kd: כֹּה — 지시부사, 약 577회. 첫째, 방식을 나타내어 '이같이, 이렇게'. 둘째, 장소를 나타내어 '여기'. 셋째, 시간을 나타내어 '이제까지'. '여호와께서 이같이 말씀하시니라'라는 선지자의 고정 어구에 쓰이는 말이 바로 이것입니다.

H0369.d: אַ֫יִן, אָ֑֫יִן cstr. אֵין subst. prop. nothing, nought; to nothing, as nothing; cstr. אֵין, very freq. as particle of negation, is not, are not, was not, were not; אֵין לְ׳, with subst., or pron., there is (was) not to … = … have, has, had, etc. not; in circumst. clauses; with inf. and ל׳, it is not to …; with prefixes
H0369.sd: a nonentity; generally used as a negative particle — else, except, fail, (father-) less, be gone, in(-curable), neither, never, no (where), none, nor, (any, thing), not, nothing, to nought, past, un(-searchable), well-nigh, without. Compare 370
H0369.kd: אַ֫יִן (연계형 אֵין) — 명사, 약 788회. 본디 '없음, 아무것도 아님'을 뜻하는 명사입니다. 연계형 אֵין은 매우 자주 부정 불변화사로 쓰여 '~이 없다, ~이 아니다'가 됩니다. אֵין לְ 구문은 '~에게 없다' 곧 '~은 가지고 있지 않다'입니다. 상황절에서 자주 쓰이며, 부정사와 함께 쓰이면 '~할 수 없다'가 됩니다. 전치사가 붙어 מֵאַיִן이 되면 '없으므로, 아무도 없이'가 됩니다. 무엇을 '없는 것처럼' 여긴다는 표현에도 쓰입니다.

H2934.d: טָמַן vb. hide, conceal; Qal; hide; often of hiding, concealing, secretly laying a snare; that which is darkened = darkness; Niph. hide thyself in the dust; Hiph. and they went and hid (it)
H2934.sd: to hide (by covering over) — hide, lay privily, in secret

H2344.d: חוֹל n.m. sand (perh. as turning or whirling)
H2344.sd: sand (as round or whirling particles) — sand

H8147.d: שְׁנַ֫יִם, שְׁתַּיִם 768 n.m. et f. du. two
H8147.sd: two; also (as ordinal) twofold — both, couple, double, second, twain, twelfth, twelve, twenty (sixscore) thousand, twice, two
H8147.kd: שְׁנַיִם (여성형 שְׁתַּיִם) — 수사 쌍수, 약 768회. '둘'. 서수처럼 쓰이면 '둘째'가 되고, '두 배, 곱절'을 뜻하기도 합니다. 다른 수와 합해져 '열둘, 스물' 같은 수를 이룹니다.

H5327a.d: [נָצָה] vb. Niph. Hiph. struggle; Niph. recipr. struggle with each other; Hiph. engage in struggle against
H5327a.sd: properly, to go forth, i.e. (by implication) to be expelled, and (consequently) desolate; causatively, to lay waste; also (specifically), to quarrel — be laid waste, runinous, strive (together)

H7563.sd: morally wrong; concretely, an (actively) bad person — condemned, guilty, ungodly, wicked (man), that did wrong

H7453.sd: an associate (more or less close) — brother, companion, fellow, friend, husband, lover, neighbour, × (an-) other

H4310.d: מִי 423 pron.interrog. who? of persons; מִי is rarely used of things, and usually where persons are understood or implied; in the gen. whose; in an indirect qu; מִי ב׳ who among … ?; strengthened and emph. forms of interrog; various rhetorical uses whose; מִי may sometimes be rendered whosoever, though, as the examples will shew, it does not really mean it; once, following a verb, any one
H4310.sd: who? (occasionally, by a peculiar idiom, of things); also (indefinitely) whoever; often used in oblique construction with prefix or suffix — any (man), × he, × him, O that! what, which, who(-m, -se, -soever), would to God
H4310.kd: מִי — 의문대명사, 약 423회. '누구?'. 주로 사람에게 쓰고, 사물에 쓰이는 일은 드문데 그런 자리도 대개 사람이 함께 떠오르는 문맥입니다. 소유격으로는 '누구의', 간접의문문에도 쓰입니다. '누가 ~하랴?'라는 수사의문으로 강한 부정을 나타내거나, '누가 ~하게 하랴'라는 형태로 간절한 소원을 나타내는 관용구가 많습니다. 문맥에 따라 '누구든지'로 옮기기도 하지만 본디 그 뜻은 아닙니다.

H8199.d: שָׁפַט 185 vb. judge, govern; Qal; act as law-giver, judge, governor; specif. decide controversy, discriminate betw. persons, in civil, political, domestic and religious questions; execute judgment; Niph; recipr., enter into controversy, plead; pass. be judged; Pô‛el = my opponent-at-law
H8199.sd: to judge, i.e. pronounce sentence (for or against); by implication, to vindicate or punish; by extenssion, to govern; passively, to litigate (literally or figuratively) — avenge, × that condemn, contend, defend, execute (judgment), (be a) judge(-ment), × needs, plead, reason, rule

H2026.d: הָרַג vb. kill, slay; Qal; kill, slay, implying ruthless violence; hence of wholesale slaughter after battle; of God’s slaying in judgment; rarely of judicial killing by men (at God’s command); of killing beasts; of killing by beasts; quite general; destroy, ruin; Niph; shall priest and prophet be slain in the sanctuary?; pass. of Qal 1 b; Pu. be slain
H2026.sd: to smite with deadly intent — destroy, out of hand, kill, murder(-er), put to (death), make (slaughter), slay(-er), × surely

H0859a.d: אַתָּ֫ה, אָ֑תָּה pron. 2 s. m. thou
H0859a.sd: thou and thee, or (plural) ye and you — thee, thou, ye, you
H0859a.kd: אַתָּה — 이인칭 남성 단수 대명사, 약 740회. '너, 당신'. 히브리어 동사가 인칭을 어미로 나타내므로, 이 대명사가 따로 나오면 대개 상대를 힘주어 가리키는 것입니다.

H0403.d: אָכֵן adv. with strong asseverative force: surely, truly; emphasizing a contrast, but indeed, but in fact
H0403.sd: firmly; figuratively, surely; also (adversative) but — but, certainly, nevertheless, surely, truly, verily

H8085.d: שָׁמַע 1152 vb. hear; Qal 1052; subj. pers. hum; י׳ (God) subj; Niph. 42; be heard, of voice, sound; be heard of; be regarded, obeyed; = (favourable) hearing was granted to their voice; Pi. he caused the people to hear; Hiph. 63; of man; י׳ subj
H8085.sd: to hear intelligently (often with implication of attention, obedience, etc.; causatively, to tell, etc.) — × attentively, call (gather) together, × carefully, × certainly, consent, consider, be content, declare, × diligently, discern, give ear, (cause to, let, make to) hear(-ken, tell), × indeed, listen, make (a) noise, (be) obedient, obey, perceive, (make a) proclaim(-ation), publish, regard, report, shew (forth), (make a) sound, × surely, tell, understand, whosoever (heareth), witness
H8085.kd: שָׁמַע — 동사, 약 1,152회. '듣다'. 칼형이 1,052회로 압도적인데, 사람이 주어인 경우와 하나님이 주어인 경우로 나뉩니다. 니팔형은 '들리다'(소리나 음성이), '~라고 전해지다', 그리고 '받아들여지다, 순종되다'로 쓰여 '그들의 간구가 들어졌다'와 같은 표현을 이룹니다. 피엘형은 '백성에게 듣게 하다' 곧 소집하다. 히필형은 '듣게 하다, 알리다'. 히브리어에서 '듣다'는 단순히 소리를 감지하는 데 그치지 않고 주의를 기울이고 순종하는 데까지 이어지므로, 문맥에 따라 '귀 기울이다, 청종하다, 순종하다, 알아듣다'로 옮깁니다.

H1245.d: [בָּקַשׁ] 224 vb. seek; Pi; seek to find; seek to secure; seek the face; desire, demand; require, exact; exact equivalent or penalty for; (late) ask, request; Pu. be sought
H1245.sd: to search out (by any method, specifically in worship or prayer); by implication, to strive after — ask, beg, beseech, desire, enquire, get, make inquisition, procure, (make) request, require, seek (for)

H1272.d: בָּרַח vb. go through, flee; Qal; go or pass through, of bar; flee; flee = hasten, come quickly; Hiph; pass through; cause to flee, put to flight
H1272.sd: to bolt, i.e. figuratively, to flee suddenly — chase (away); drive away, fain, flee (away), put to flight, make haste, reach, run away, shoot

H3427.d: יָשַׁב 1090 vb. sit, remain, dwell; Qal; sit; sit, sit down; sit down; sit = be set (as a jewel); remain, stay, tarry; with special emphasis of qualifying phr; dwell, have one’s abode; of a land or city, sit, abide, seated in its place, fig. for be inhabited; Niph. be inhabited, of land; Pi. and they shall set their encampments in thee; Hiph; cause to sit; cause to abide; cause to dwell; cause cities to be inhabited; marry (prop. give a dwelling to); Hoph. and ye be made to dwell alone in the midst of the land
H3427.sd: properly, to sit down (specifically as judge. in ambush, in quiet); by implication, to dwell, to remain; causatively, to settle, to marry — (make to) abide(-ing), continue, (cause to, make to) dwell(-ing), ease self, endure, establish, × fail, habitation, haunt, (make to) inhabit(-ant), make to keep (house), lurking, × marry(-ing), (bring again to) place, remain, return, seat, set(-tle), (down-) sit(-down, still, -ting down, -ting (place) -uate), take, tarry
H3427.kd: יָשַׁב — 동사, 약 1,090회. '앉다, 머물다, 거하다'. 칼형에서 (1) 앉다, 앉히다, 자리에 앉다, (2) 보석이 물려 있듯 '박혀 있다', (3) 남다, 머무르다, 지체하다, (4) 살다, 거처를 두다, (5) 땅이나 성읍이 주어일 때는 '제자리에 자리 잡고 있다'에서 비유적으로 '사람이 살고 있다'가 됩니다. 니팔형은 땅이 '사람 사는 곳이 되다'. 피엘형은 '진을 치게 하다'. 히필형은 앉히다·머물게 하다·거하게 하다·성읍에 사람이 살게 하다, 그리고 '거처를 준다'는 데서 나와 '아내로 맞게 하다'로도 쓰입니다. 호팔형은 '홀로 살게 되다'.

H4080.d: מִדְיָן n.pr.m; son of Abraham and Keturah; an Arabian tribe; the land of Midian; land on Ælanitic gulf
H4080.sd: Midjan, a son of Abraham; also his country and (collectively) his descendants — Midian, Midianite

H0875.d: בְּאֵר n.f. well, pit; a well, often as made by digging; pit; as n.pr.loc; a station of Isr. in desert; 8 miles north of Eleutheropolis
H0875.sd: a pit; especially a well — pit, well

H3548.sd: literally one officiating, a priest; also (by courtesy) an acting priest (although a layman) — chief ruler, × own, priest, prince, principal officer
H3548.kd: כֹּהֵן — 남성명사, 약 750회. '제사장'. 문자적으로는 예식을 집전하는 사람입니다. 스트롱은 제사장 직분에 있지 않은 사람이라도 그에 준하는 지위에 있으면 예우로 이 말을 썼다고 밝히며, 그래서 '으뜸 관원, 방백'으로 옮기는 곳도 있다고 설명합니다.

H7651.d: שֶׁ֫בַע, שִׁבְעָה 394 n.m. et f. seven
H7651.sd: seven (as the sacred full one); also (adverbially) seven times; by implication, a week; by extension, an indefinite number — ( by) seven(-fold),-s, (-teen, -teenth), -th, times). Compare 7658
H7651.kd: שֶׁ֫בַע (여성형 שִׁבְעָה) — 수사, 약 394회. '일곱'. 부사로 '일곱 번'을 뜻하기도 하고, 함의상 '한 주간'을 가리키며, 더 넓게는 '여러 번, 온전한 수'를 나타냅니다. 스트롱은 이 수가 거룩하고 온전한 수로 여겨졌다고 밝힙니다.

H1802.d: דָּלָה vb. draw (water); Qal draw; Pi. thou hast drawn me up
H1802.sd: properly, to dangle, i.e. to let down a bucket (for drawing out water); figuratively, to deliver — draw (out), × enough, lift up

H7298a.d: [רַ֫הַט] n.[m.] trough (where water is collected?);—for watering cattle
H7298a.sd: a channel or watering-box; by resemblance a ringlet of hair (as forming parallel lines) — gallery, gutter, trough

H8248.d: [שָׁקָה] vb. Hiph. cause to drink water, give to drink; Hiph; water, irrigate, ground; water, give drink to; Pu. the marrow of his bones is watered, (refreshed, invigorated)
H8248.sd: to quaff, i.e. (causatively) to irrigate or furnish a potion to — cause to (give, give to, let, make to) drink, drown, moisten, water. See 7937, 8354

H6629.d: צֹאן 273 n.coll.f. small cattle, sheep and goats, flock, flocks
H6629.sd: a collective name for a flock (of sheep or goats); also figuratively (of men) — (small) cattle, flock ( -s), lamb ( -s), sheep(-cote, -fold, -shearer, -herds)

H0001.d: אָב 1101 n.m. father; father of individual; of God as father of his people; head of household, family or clan; ancestor; originator or patron of a class, profession, or art; fig. of producer, generator; fig. of benevolence & protection; term of respect & honor; specif., ruler, chief (late)
H0001.sd: father, in a literal and immediate, or figurative and remote application — chief, (fore-) father(-less), × patrimony, principal. Compare names in 'Abi-'
H0001.kd: אָב — 남성명사, 약 1,101회. '아버지'. 첫째, 한 개인의 아버지. 둘째, 자기 백성의 아버지 되신 하나님. 셋째, 가정·가문·씨족의 어른. 넷째, 조상. 다섯째, 어떤 계층·직업·기술을 처음 연 이나 그 후원자. 여섯째, 비유적으로 무엇을 낳거나 생기게 한 이. 일곱째, 비유적으로 자애와 보호를 베푸는 이. 여덟째, 존경과 예우를 담은 호칭. 아홉째, 후기 용법으로 통치자, 우두머리.

H7462b.d: רָעָה 167 vb. pasture, tend, graze; Qal; trans; intrans; Niph. poss; Hiph. v
H7462b.sd: to tend a flock; i.e. pasture it; intransitively, to graze (literally or figuratively); generally to rule; by extension, to associate with (as a friend) — × break, companion, keep company with, devour, eat up, evil entreat, feed, use as a friend, make friendship with, herdman, keep (sheep) (-er), pastor, shearing house, shepherd, wander, waste

H1644.d: [גָּרַשׁ] vb. drive out, cast out; Qal cast out, thrust out; Niph. be driven away; Pi. drive out, away; Pu. subj. Israelites; subj. despised and miserable outcasts
H1644.sd: to drive out from a possession; especially to expatriate or divorce — cast up (out), divorced (woman), drive away (forth, out), expel, × surely put away, trouble, thrust out

H3467.d: [יָשַׁע] vb. Hiph. deliver; Niph. intrans. and pass; Niph; be liberated, saved (prop. placed in freedom); be saved in battle, victorious; Hiph; deliver, save (prop. give width and breadth to, liberate); save from moral troubles; give victory to
H3467.sd: properly, to be open, wide or free, i.e. (by implication) to be safe; causatively, to free or succor — × at all, avenging, defend, deliver(-er), help, preserve, rescue, be safe, bring (having) salvation, save(-iour), get victory

H7467.d: רְעוּאֵל n.pr.m; Moses’ father-in-law; Edomite; Gadite; Benjamite
H7467.sd: Reuel, the name of Moses' father-in-law, also of an Edomite and an Israelite — Raguel, Reuel

H4116a.d: [מָהַר] vb. hasten; Niph. be hurried = anxious, disturbed; hasty, precipitate; impetuous; Pi; hasten, make haste = go or come quickly; hasten vb; trans. hasten, = prepare quickly; = bring quickly; = do quickly
H4116a.sd: properly, to be liquid or flow easily, i.e. (by implication); to hurry (in a good or a bad sense); often used (with another verb) adverbially, promptly — be carried headlong, fearful, (cause to make, in, make) haste(-n, -ily), (be) hasty, (fetch, make ready) × quickly, rash, × shortly, (be so) × soon, make speed, × speedily, × straightway, × suddenly, swift

H5337.d: [נָצַל] 212 vb. not in Qal; Pi. strip, plunder; Niph. deliver oneself, be delivered Hiph. snatch away, deliver; Niph; reflex. tear oneself away, deliver oneself; passive, be torn out or away; Pi; strip off, spoil; deliver; Hiph; take away, snatch away; rescue, recover; deliver from; deliver from sin and guilt; Hoph. as a brand plucked out of the burning; Hithp. and they stripped themselves of their ornaments
H5337.sd: to snatch away, whether in a good or a bad sense — × at all, defend, deliver (self), escape, × without fail, part, pluck, preserve, recover, rescue, rid, save, spoil, strip, × surely, take (out)

H5800a.d: עָזַב 213 vb. leave, forsake, loose; Qal; leave, c. acc; leave, abandon, forsake; let loose, set free, let go; Niph; be left to; be forsaken, of house of God; Pu. (or Qal pass.) be deserted, of city
H5800a.sd: to loosen, i.e. relinquish, permit, etc — commit self, fail, forsake, fortify, help, leave (destitute, off), refuse, × surely

H0398.d: אָכַל 806 vb. eat; Qal; eat, human subject; of beasts, birds, etc., eat, devour; fig. of fire, devour, consume; of sword, devour, slay; in genl., devour, consume, destroy; fig. of oppression, devour the poor; Niph; be eaten by man; be devoured by fire, consumed; be wasted, destroyed, of flesh; Pu. be consumed; Hiph; cause to eat, feed with; cause to devoure, obj. sword
H0398.sd: to eat (literally or figuratively) — × at all, burn up, consume, devour(-er, up), dine, eat(-er, up), feed (with), food, × freely, × in...wise(-deed, plenty), (lay) meat, × quite
H0398.kd: אָכַל — 동사, 약 806회. '먹다'. 칼형에서 사람이 먹다, 짐승이나 새가 먹어 치우다, 비유적으로 불이 삼키다, 칼이 삼키다 곧 죽이다, 널리 삼켜 없애다·멸하다, 학대를 두고 '가난한 자를 삼키다'로 쓰입니다. 니팔형은 '먹히다, 불에 살라지다, 살이 축나 없어지다'. 푸알형은 '살라지다'. 히필형은 '먹이다', 목적어가 칼이면 '삼키게 하다'. 이 말이 제사와 관련해 쓰이면 제물을 불사르는 것도 가리킵니다.

H3899.d: לֶ֫חֶם 296 n.m. and (rarely) f. bread, food
H3899.sd: food (for man or beast), especially bread, or grain (for making it) — (shew-) bread, × eat, food, fruit, loaf, meat, victuals

H2974.d: [יָאַל] vb. only Hiph. shew willingness, be pleased, determine, undertake to do anything (and do it)
H2974.sd: properly, to yield, especially assent; hence (pos.) to undertake as an act of volition — assay, begin, be content, please, take upon, × willingly, would

H1647.d: גֵּרְשֹׁם n.pr.m; son of Moses and Ṣipporah; a son of Levi; a son of Phinehas
H1647.sd: Gereshom, the name of four Israelites — Gershom

H1616.sd: properly, a guest; by implication, a foreigner — alien, sojourner, stranger

H5237.sd: strange, in a variety of degrees and applications (foreign, non-relative, adulterous, different, wonderful) — alien, foreigner, outlandish, strange(-r, woman)

H0584.d: [אָנַח] vb. only Niph. sigh, groan; sigh, in token of grief; in physical distress; groan of cattle

H2199.d: [זָעַק] vb. cry, cry out, call; Qal; call, to one's aid; cry, cry out, in need; Niph. be called together, assemble, join; Hiph; call, call out, or together, for military service; make a crying; have proclamation made; call out, or at
H2199.sd: to shriek (from anguish or danger); by analogy, (as a herald) to announce or convene publicly — assemble, call (together), (make a) cry (out), come with such a company, gather (together), cause to be proclaimed

H2142.d: זָכַר vb. remember; Qal; Human subj; remember, recall, call to mind, usu. as affecting present feeling, thought or action; remember persons (human subj.); remember י׳; remember; think of or on, call to mind something present or future; remember a day, to observe, commemorate it; remember, with implied mention of, obj; Subj. י׳ (אלהִם); remember persons; remember the distress of his servants; their devotion; remember his own covenant (with them); his mercy; extenuating circumstances; remember sins, idolatries; Niph; be brought to remembrance, remembered, thought of, usu. c. neg; neg. be not remembered = no longer exist, of name of Israel, as nation; be remembered, of particular days, in order to be observed, commemorated; Hiph; cause to remember, remind; cause to be remembered, keep in remembrance; mention; record, only pt; of sacrifice, make a memorial
H2142.sd: properly, to mark (so as to be recognized), i.e. to remember; by implication, to mention; to be male — × burn (incense), × earnestly, be male, (make) mention (of), be mindful, recount, record(-er), remember, make to be remembered, bring (call, come, keep, put) to (in) remembrance, × still, think on, × well

H1285.d: בְּרִית 285 n.f. covenant; between men; treaty, alliance, league; constitution, ordinance, between monarch and subjects; agreement, pledge; alliance of friendship between David and Jonathan; alliance of marriage; between God and man; alliance of friendship; covenant, as a divine constitution or ordinance with signs or pledges; Phrases; covenant making; covenant keeping; covenant violation
H1285.sd: a compact (because made by passing between pieces of flesh) — confederacy, (con-) feder(-ate), covenant, league

H0085.d: אַבְרָם n.pr.m. (id., Thes al. exalted father) Abram = אַבְרָהָם Abraham
H0085.sd: Abraham, the later name of Abram — Abraham

H3327.d: יִצְחָק 108, יִשְׂחָק 4 n.pr.m. Isaac, son of Abr. and Sarah (he laugheth)
H3327.sd: Jitschak (or Isaac), son of Abraham — Isaac. Compare 3446

H3503.d: יִתְרוֹ n.pr.m. father of Moses’ wife

H2859a.d: חֹתֵן n.verb; m. wife's father; f. wife's mother
H2859a.sd: to give (a daughter) away in marriage; hence (generally) to contract affinity by marriage — join in affinity, father in law, make marriages, mother in law, son in law

H5090a.d: נָהַג vb. drive, conduct; Qal; drive; fig. my heart behaving itself in wisdom; Pi; drive away, lead off; lead on, guide; cause to drive
H5090a.sd: to drive forth (a person, an animal or chariot), i.e. lead, carry away; reflexively, to proceed (i.e. impel or guide oneself); also (from the panting induced by effort), to sigh — acquaint, bring (away), carry away, drive (away), lead (away, forth), (be) guide, lead (away, forth)

H0310a.d: אַחַר prop. subst. the hinder or following part; adv; of place, behind; of time, afterwards; prep; of place, behind, after; of time, after; conj. after that
H0310a.sd: properly, the hind part; generally used as an adverb or conjunction, after (in various senses) — after (that, -ward), again, at, away from, back (from, -side), behind, beside, by, follow (after, -ing), forasmuch, from, hereafter, hinder end, + out (over) live, + persecute, posterity, pursuing, remnant, seeing, since, thence(-forth), when, with
H0310a.kd: אַחַר — 본디 '뒤쪽, 뒤따르는 부분'을 뜻하는 명사입니다. 첫째, 부사로 장소를 나타내어 '뒤에', 시간을 나타내어 '그 후에'. 둘째, 전치사로 '~뒤에, ~를 따라' 그리고 '~후에'. 셋째, 접속사로 '~한 뒤에'. 복수형 אַחֲרֵי가 전치사로 더 자주 쓰입니다. 문맥에 따라 '뒤따르다, 남은 자, 후손, ~한 이래로'로 옮기기도 합니다.

H4057b.d: מִדְבָר 270 n.m. wilderness; tracts of land, used for the pasturage of flocks and herds; uninhabited land; large tracts of such land bearing various names, in certain districts of which there might be towns and cities; fig
H4057b.sd: a pasture (i.e. open field, whither cattle are driven); by implication, a desert; also speech (including its organs) — desert, south, speech, wilderness

H2022.d: הַר 568 n.m. mountain, hill, hill-country; mountain, hill; hill-country, mountain-region
H2022.sd: a mountain or range of hills (sometimes used figuratively) — hill (country), mount(-ain), × promotion
H2022.kd: הַר — 남성명사, 약 568회. '산, 언덕, 산지'. 첫째, 하나의 산이나 언덕. 둘째, 산이 이어진 지역 곧 산지. 시문에서는 비유적으로도 쓰입니다.

H2722.sd: Choreb, a (generic) name for the Sinaitic mountains — Horeb

H4397.d: מַלְאָךְ 214 n.m. messenger; messenger; angel, as messenger of God; the theophanic angel
H4397.sd: a messenger; specifically, of God, i.e. an angel (also a prophet, priest or teacher) — ambassador, angel, king, messenger

H3068.d: יהוה c. 6823 i.e. יַהְוֶה n.pr.dei Yahweh, the proper name of the God of Israel—(1. MT יְהֹוָה 6518 (Qr אֲדֹנָי), or יֱהֹוִה 305 (Qr אֱלֹהִים) 2. Many recent scholars explain יַהְוֶה as Hiph. of הוה (= היה) the one bringing into being, life-giver); יהוה is not used by E in Gn, but is given as the name of the God who revealed Himself to Moses at Horeb; יהוה is used with אלהים and suffixes, especially in D; the phrase † אֲנִי יהוה is noteworthy; יהוה is also used with several predicates, to form sacred names of holy places of Yahweh
H3068.sd: (the) self-Existent or Eternal; Jeho-vah, Jewish national name of God — Jehovah, the Lord. Compare 3050, 3069
H3068.kd: יהוה — 신명 고유명사. 이스라엘의 하나님의 고유한 이름으로 약 6,823회 나타납니다. 마소라 본문은 이 네 글자에 아도나이(주)의 모음을 붙여 적었고(6,518회), 아도나이가 앞에 올 때는 엘로힘의 모음을 붙였습니다(305회). 근래 학자들은 본래 발음을 '야웨'로 보며, 어원을 '하야'(있다·되다)의 사역형으로 풀어 '있게 하시는 분·생명을 주시는 분'으로 이해합니다. 창세기의 엘로힘 자료에는 쓰이지 않고, 호렙에서 모세에게 자신을 드러내신 하나님의 이름으로 제시됩니다. '나는 여호와니라'라는 어구가 특히 두드러집니다.

H3827.d: לֶהָבָה n.f. id. [לַ֫הַב]; flame, poet; point, head of spear

H0784.d: אֵשׁ 377 n.f. fire; fire, of conflagration; of supernatural fire; fire for cooking, roasting, parching; esp. of altar fire; fig. of Yahweh's anger; in various combinations
H0784.sd: fire (literally or figuratively) — burning, fiery, fire, flaming, hot
H0784.kd: אֵשׁ — 여성명사, 약 377회. '불'. 첫째, 불이 나 타는 것. 둘째, 초자연적인 불. 셋째, 굽고 삶고 볶는 데 쓰는 불. 넷째, 특히 제단의 불. 다섯째, 비유적으로 여호와의 진노. 하나님이 불 가운데 나타나시는 장면과 '소멸하는 불'이라는 표현이 두드러집니다.

H5572.d: סְנֶה n.m. a thorny bush, perh. blackberry bush

H1197a.d: [בָּעַר] vb. burn, consume; Qal burn; Pi; kindle; burn; fig. consume, utterly remove; Pu. burn (i.e. be supplied with fire), of fire-jar; Hiph; kindle; burn up
H1197a.sd: to kindle, i.e. consume (by fire or by eating); to be (-come) brutish — be brutish, bring (put, take) away, burn, (cause to) eat (up), feed, heat, kindle, set (on fire), waste

H5493.d: סוּר and [שׂוּר] 300 vb. turn aside; Qal; turn aside, out of one's course; depart; of lifeless things = be removed; = come to an end; Pô‛lēl he turned aside my ways (my steps); Hiph; cause to (turn aside,) depart, common word for remove, take away; rarer uses; Pô‛lēl be taken away, removed
H5493.sd: to turn off (literally or figuratively) — be(-head), bring, call back, decline, depart, eschew, get (you), go (aside), × grievous, lay away (by), leave undone, be past, pluck away, put (away, down), rebel, remove (to and fro), revolt, × be sour, take (away, off), turn (aside, away, in), withdraw, be without

H4994.d: נָא part. of entreaty or exhortation, I (we) pray, now (enclitic)
H4994.sd: 'I pray', 'now', or 'then'; added mostly to verbs (in the Imperative or Future), or to interjections, occasionally to an adverb or conjunction — I beseech (pray) thee (you), go to, now, oh
H4994.kd: נָא — 간청이나 권고를 나타내는 불변화사, 약 402회. '청컨대, 부디, 자'. 주로 명령형이나 미완료 뒤에 붙어 말을 부드럽게 하고, 감탄사나 부사·접속사 뒤에 붙기도 합니다. 앞말에 붙여 읽는 후접어라 따로 강세를 받지 않습니다. 우리말로는 '~하소서, 원컨대, 이제' 정도로 옮기거나, 어조만 살리고 굳이 옮기지 않기도 합니다.

H4758.d: מַרְאֶה 102 n.m. sight, appearance, vision; sight, phenomenon, spectacle; appearance; appearance, sight, vision; in gen. what is seen; specif. a (supernat.) vision; sight, vision = power of seeing (and enjoying), late
H4758.sd: a view (the act of seeing); also an appearance (the thing seen), whether (real) a shape (especially if handsome, comeliness; often plural the looks), or (mental) a vision — × apparently, appearance(-reth), × as soon as beautiful(-ly), countenance, fair, favoured, form, goodly, to look (up) on (to), look(-eth), pattern, to see, seem, sight, visage, vision

H1419a.d: גָּדוֹל 622 adj. great; in magnitude and extent; in number; in intensity; in sound, loud; in age; in importance; in phrases; cstr; as subst. concr. do great things; † as subst. neut. greatness of arm
H1419a.sd: great (in any sense); hence, older; also insolent — aloud, elder(-est), exceeding(-ly), far, (man of) great (man, matter, thing,-er,-ness), high, long, loud, mighty, more, much, noble, proud thing, × sore, (×) very
H1419a.kd: גָּדוֹל — 형용사, 약 622회. '큰'. 첫째, 크기와 넓이가 큰 것. 둘째, 수가 많은 것. 셋째, 정도가 심한 것. 넷째, 소리가 큰 것 곧 '큰 소리로'. 다섯째, 나이가 많은 것 곧 '맏이, 연장자'. 여섯째, 중요한 것 곧 '위대한, 높은'. 연계형으로 쓰이면 '~이 큰 자'가 되고, 명사처럼 쓰여 '큰일을 행하다'라는 표현을 이룹니다. 스트롱은 여기서 '거만한'이라는 부정적 뜻도 나온다고 밝힙니다.

H0408.d: אַל adv. of negation, denying however, not objectively as a fact, but subjectively as a wish, expressing therefore a deprecation or prohibition
H0408.sd: not (the qualified negation, used as a deprecative); once (Job 24:25) as a noun, nothing — nay, neither, + never, no, nor, not, nothing (worth), rather than
H0408.kd: אַל — 부정 부사, 약 725회. '~하지 말라'. 같은 부정어인 לֹא가 사실을 객관적으로 부정하는 데 견주어, 이 말은 주관적인 바람을 담아 만류하거나 금지합니다. 그래서 대개 미완료 단축형과 함께 쓰여 '~하지 마시오, ~하지 않기를'이 됩니다. 욥기 24장 25절에서는 명사처럼 쓰여 '헛것'을 뜻합니다.

H7126.d: [קָרֵב], קָרַב 279 vb. come near, approach; Qal 93 approach; Niph. he shall be brought unto God; Pi. cause to approach, bring near; Hiph. 177; bring near, bring, present; of time; as term techn. (c. 158 t.), chiefly Ez HP, bring near, of presenting, dedicating, or offering to י׳
H7126.sd: to approach (causatively, bring near) for whatever purpose — (cause to) approach, (cause to) bring (forth, near), (cause to) come (near, nigh), (cause to) draw near (nigh), go (near), be at hand, join, be near, offer, present, produce, make ready, stand, take

H5394.d: נָשַׁל vb. 1. intrans. slip or drop off; also trans.: 2. draw off. 3. clear away; Qal; slip or drop off; draw off sandal fr. foot; clear away nations; Pi. he cleared the Jews entirely out of Elath
H5394.sd: to pluck off, i.e. divest, eject or drop — cast (out), drive, loose, put off (out), slip

H5275.sd: properly, a sandal tongue; by extension a sandal or slipper (sometimes as a symbol of occupancy, a refusal to marry, or of something valueless) — dryshod, (pair of) shoe((-latchet), -s)

H7272.d: רֶ֫גֶל 247 n.f. foot; foot; three times (feet, paces)
H7272.sd: a foot (as used in walking); by implication, a step; by euphemistically the pudenda — × be able to endure, × according as, × after, × coming, × follow, (broken-)foot(-ed, -stool), × great toe, × haunt, × journey, leg, piss, possession, time

H4725.d: מָקוֹם, מָקֹם 399 n.m. standing-place, place; standing-place; station, where soldiers are placed; post, office; place where a thing belongs; esp; place of human abode; of י׳’s abode; place; in gen. place, locality, spot; space, room; space, distance, between; region, quarter, direction; peculiar uses
H4725.sd: properly, a standing, i.e. a spot; but used widely of a locality (general or specific); also (figuratively) of a condition (of body or mind) — country, × home, × open, place, room, space, × whither(-soever)
H4725.kd: מָקוֹם — 남성명사, 약 399회. '곳, 장소'. 본디 '서 있는 자리'를 뜻합니다. 첫째, 서는 자리. 둘째, 군사가 배치된 위치. 셋째, 맡은 직임. 넷째, 무엇이 놓여야 할 제자리. 다섯째, 사람이 사는 곳. 여섯째, 하나님이 계신 곳. 일곱째, 일반적인 장소·지점. 여덟째, 자리·공간. 아홉째, 사이의 거리. 열째, 지역, 방면. 스트롱은 비유적으로 몸이나 마음의 상태를 가리키기도 한다고 밝힙니다.

H5975.d: עָמַד 620 take one's stand, stand; Qal 435; take one's stand, and (esp. pt.) stand, be in a standing attitude; stand forth; take a stand against, in opposition to; present oneself before; attend upon, be(come) servant of; stand afar; stand (silent); stand (appealingly); stand, subj. רֶגֶל; stand, of water; stand still, stop, cease moving; = be inactive; = be attentive; stop, cease doing a thing; tarry, delay; remain; continue, abide; endure; be steadfast; persist; make a stand, hold one's ground; stand upright; arise, appear, come on the scene; stand forth, appear = come into being; rise up as foe; rare usages; Hiph. 83; station, set; cause to stand firm; cause to stand up, set up, erect; present one before king; appoint; other meanings; Hoph. be presented
H5975.sd: to stand, in various relations (literal and figurative, intransitive and transitive) — abide (behind), appoint, arise, cease, confirm, continue, dwell, be employed, endure, establish, leave, make, ordain, be (over), place, (be) present (self), raise up, remain, repair, serve, set (forth, over, -tle, up), (make to, make to be at a, with-) stand (by, fast, firm, still, up), (be at a) stay (up), tarry
H5975.kd: עָמַד — 동사, 약 620회. '서다, 자리를 잡다'. 칼형이 435회로, 자리에 서다, 나서다, 맞서 대적하다, 누구 앞에 나아가다, 섬기는 자가 되다, 멀찍이 서다, 잠잠히 서다, 서서 간구하다, 물이 멈춰 서다, 움직임을 그치고 멎다, 하던 일을 그만두다, 지체하다, 남다, 계속되다, 견디다, 굳게 서다, 버티다, 똑바로 서다, 나타나다, 대적으로 일어서다 등으로 쓰입니다. 히필형은 83회로 '세우다, 두다, 굳게 세우다, 일으켜 세우다, 왕 앞에 세우다, 세워 임명하다'. 호팔형은 '세워지다'. 같은 '서다'라도 קוּם이 일어서는 동작에 가깝다면 이 말은 그 자리에 서 있는 상태에 가깝습니다.

H0127.d: אֲדָמָה 224 n.f. ground, land (as tilled); ground (as tilled, yielding sustenance); piece of ground, landed property; earth as material substance; ground as earth's visible surface; land, territory, country; whole earth, inhabited earth; n. pr. loc. city in Naphtali
H0127.sd: soil (from its general redness) — country, earth, ground, husband(-man) (-ry), land

H6944.sd: a sacred place or thing; rarely abstract, sanctity — consecrated (thing), dedicated (thing), hallowed (thing), holiness, (× most) holy (× day, portion, thing), saint, sanctuary
H6944.kd: קֹ֫דֶשׁ — 남성명사, 약 469회. '거룩함, 성별됨'. 본디 뜻은 '따로 구별되어 있음'입니다. 흔히 구체적으로 거룩한 곳이나 거룩한 물건을 가리켜 '성소, 성물, 예물'이 되고, 드물게 추상적으로 '거룩'이 됩니다. 겹쳐 쓴 '지성소'(거룩한 것 중의 거룩한 것)라는 표현이 여기서 나옵니다.

H0595.kd: אָנֹכִי — 일인칭 단수 대명사, 약 359회. '나'. 같은 뜻의 אֲנִי(H0589)보다 긴 형태로, 대체로 더 오래된 문헌에 많이 나타납니다. 동사가 이미 인칭을 나타내므로 이 대명사가 따로 쓰이면 강조하는 것입니다.

H5641.d: סָתַר vb. hide, conceal; Niph; hide oneself; be hid, concealed; Pi. Imv. carefully hide (i.e. shelter) the outcasts; Pu. Pt. love carefully concealed; Hithp. hide oneself carefully; Hiph. conceal, hide
H5641.sd: to hide (by covering), literally or figuratively — be absent, keep close, conceal, hide (self), (keep) secret, × surely

H5027.d: [נָבַט] vb. Pi., Hiph. look; Pi. look; Hiph. look
H5027.sd: to scan, i.e. look intently at; by implication, to regard with pleasure, favor or care — (cause to) behold, consider, look (down), regard, have respect, see

H5065.d: [נָגַשׂ] vb. press, drive, oppress, exact; Qal; press, drive to work; exact; Pt. (= subst.) driver, taskmaster; Niph. hard pressed by enemy; treated harshly of suffering servant of י׳; recipr. tyrannize over each other
H5065.sd: to drive (an animal, a workman, a debtor, an army); by implication, to tax, harass, tyrannize — distress, driver, exact(-or), oppress(-or), × raiser of taxes, taskmaster

H4341.sd: anguish or (figuratively) affliction — grief, pain, sorrow

H7342.sd: roomy, in any (or every) direction, literally or figuratively — broad, large, at liberty, proud, wide

H2100.sd: to flow freely (as water), i.e. (specifically) to have a (sexual) flux; figuratively, to waste away; also to overflow — flow, gush out, have a (running) issue, pine away, run

H2461.sd: milk (as the richness of kine) — cheese, milk, sucking

H1706.sd: honey (from its stickiness); by analogy, syrup — honey(-comb)

H3669a.sd: a Kenaanite or inhabitant of Kenaan; by implication, a pedlar (the Canaanites standing for their neighbors the Ishmaelites, who conducted mercantile caravans) — Canaanite, merchant, trafficker

H2850.sd: a Chittite, or descendant of Cheth — Hittite, Hittities

H0567.d: אֱמֹרִי n.pr.m.coll. Amorites (perh. = mountain-dwellers); called son of Canaan; a chief people dispossessed by Hebrews; adj.gent
H0567.sd: an Emorite, one of the Canaanitish tribes — Amorite

H6522.sd: a Perizzite, one of the Canaanitish tribes — Perizzite

H2340.sd: a Chivvite, one of the aboriginal tribes of Palestine — Hivite

H2983.d: יְבוּסִי, יְבֻסִי; adj. gent. Jebusite, Jebusites; Jerusalem
H2983.sd: a Jebusite or inhabitant of Jebus — Jebusite(-s)

H6258.d: עַתָּ֫ה 435, עָ֑֫תָּה, adv. of time, now
H6258.sd: at this time, whether adverb, conjunction or expletive — henceforth, now, straightway, this time, whereas
H6258.kd: עַתָּ֫ה — 시간을 나타내는 부사, 약 435회. '이제, 지금'. 앞의 말을 받아 결론이나 권고로 넘어갈 때 '그런즉 이제'처럼 접속사에 가깝게 쓰이기도 합니다.

H3905.d: לָחַץ vb. squeeze, press, fig. oppress; Qal; squeeze, press; oppress; Niph. squeeze oneself
H3905.sd: properly, to press, i.e. (figuratively) to distress — afflict, crush, force, hold fast, oppress(-or), thrust self

H5973a.d: עִם prep. with; of fellowship and companionship; of aid; Of actions done jointly with another; If the common action be of the nature of a contest or combat, with in the sense of against; Of dealing with a person, or of the relation in which one stands with, or towards, another; Of a common lot together with the wicked; Of equality or resemblance generally aid; Of time, as long as; Of a locality, close to, beside; Of persons, עִם is spec; in the house or family or service of; In possession of; In the custody or care of; Beside = except; With = friendly with; Idiom. of a thought or purpose present with one; Metaph. together with = in spite of, notwithstanding
H5973a.sd: adverb or preposition, with (i.e. in conjunction with), in varied applications; specifically, equally with; often with prepositional prefix (and then usually unrepresented in English) — accompanying, against, and, as (× long as), before, beside, by (reason of), for all, from (among, between), in, like, more than, of, (un-) to, with(-al)
H5973a.kd: עִם — 전치사. '~와 함께'. 첫째, 사귐과 동행. 둘째, 도움. 셋째, 함께 하는 행동. 넷째, 그 행동이 겨룸이나 싸움이면 '~에 맞서'가 됩니다. 다섯째, 사람을 대하는 태도나 사람 사이의 관계. 여섯째, 같은 처지에 놓임(예: 악인과 함께 같은 몫을 받다). 일곱째, 대등함이나 닮음. 여덟째, 시간을 나타내어 '~하는 동안'. 아홉째, 장소를 나타내어 '~곁에'. 사람과 함께 쓰이면 '그 집에·그 밑에서 일하며', '~의 소유로', '~의 보살핌 아래', '~을 제외하고', '~와 사이좋게'가 되고, 마음에 품은 생각을 두고 '~에게 있는 뜻'을 나타내기도 합니다. 비유적으로는 '~에도 불구하고'가 됩니다.

H0226.d: אוֹת n.m. 79 (f. ) sign; sign, pledge, token; signs, omens promised by prophets as pledges of certain predicted events; sign, symbol of prophets; signs, miracles, as pledges or attestations of divine presence & interposition; signs, memorials; sign, pledge of covenant; ensigns, standards; signs, tokens of changes of weather & times
H0226.sd: a signal (literally or figuratively), as a flag, beacon, monument, omen, prodigy, evidence, etc — mark, miracle, (en-) sign, token

H5769.d: עוֹלָם 439 n.m. long duration, antiquity, futurity
H5769.sd: properly, concealed, i.e. the vanishing point; generally, time out of mind (past or future), i.e. (practically) eternity; frequentatively, adverbial (especially with prepositional prefix) always — alway(-s), ancient (time), any more, continuance, eternal, (for, (n-)) ever(-lasting, -more, of old), lasting, long (time), (of) old (time), perpetual, at any time, (beginning of the) world ( without end). Compare 5331, 5703
H5769.kd: עוֹלָם — 남성명사, 약 439회. '오랜 세월'. 지난 쪽으로는 '옛적, 태고'를, 앞으로는 '앞날, 영원'을 가리킵니다. 스트롱은 본디 '감추어진 것' 곧 눈에 보이지 않는 아득한 지점을 뜻한다고 보아, 기억이 미치지 못하는 시간을 나타낸다고 설명합니다. 전치사와 함께 쓰여 '영원히, 대대로, 예로부터'가 됩니다. 철학적인 '영원'이라기보다 '끝을 가늠할 수 없이 긴 시간'에 가깝습니다.

H2143.sd: a memento, abstractly recollection (rarely if ever); by implication, commemoration — memorial, memory, remembrance, scent

H0622.d: אָסַף 209 vb. gather, remove; Qal; gather, collect; gather an individual into company of others; bring up the rear of; gather and take away, remove, withdraw; Niph; assemble, be gathered, reflex; pass. of Qal 2; Pass. of Qal 4; be taken away, removed, perish; Pi; gather harvest; take in, receive into; as subst. rearguard, rearward; Pu. be gathered, of men; Hithp. gather themselves
H0622.sd: to gather for any purpose; hence, to receive, take away, i.e. remove (destroy, leave behind, put up, restore, etc.) — assemble, bring, consume, destroy, felch, gather (in, together, up again), × generally, get (him), lose, put all together, receive, recover (another from leprosy), (be) rereward, × surely, take (away, into, up), × utterly, withdraw

H2205.d: זָקֵן adj. old; old, of human beings; usu. as subst; old man (or woman); elder
H2205.sd: old — aged, ancient (man), elder(-est), old (man, men and...women), senator

H6485a.d: פָּקַד 303 vb. attend to, visit, muster, appoint; Qal; pay attention to, observe (with care, practical interest); attend to, in act, see to; seek (with interest, desire); seek in vain, need, miss, lack; specif. visit, c. acc., for different purposes; c. עַל pers., visit upon; pass in review, muster (nearly = number), c. acc; appoint; Niph; be (sought, i.e. needed) missed, lacking; be visited (graciously); be visited upon, עַל pers; be appointed; Pi. (intens.) muster a host; Pu. be passed in review; be caused to miss, deprived; Hithp. be mustered; Hothp. id; Hiph; c. acc. pers. set (over), make overseer; c. acc. rei (implic.); commit, entrust; deposit; Hoph; be visited in punishment; be deposited; be made overseer
H6485a.sd: to visit (with friendly or hostile intent); by analogy, to oversee, muster, charge, care for, miss, deposit, etc — appoint, × at all, avenge, bestow, (appoint to have the, give a) charge, commit, count, deliver to keep, be empty, enjoin, go see, hurt, do judgment, lack, lay up, look, make, × by any means, miss, number, officer, (make) overseer, have (the) oversight, punish, reckon, (call to) remember(-brance), set (over), sum, × surely, visit, want

H6963a.sd: a voice or sound — aloud, bleating, crackling, cry ( out), fame, lightness, lowing, noise, hold peace, (pro-) claim, proclamation, sing, sound, spark, thunder(-ing), voice, yell
H6963a.kd: קוֹל — 남성명사, 약 506회. '소리, 음성'. 사람의 목소리뿐 아니라 짐승의 울음, 나팔 소리, 천둥소리, 발소리 등 온갖 소리를 아울러 가리킵니다. '소리를 높이다'는 크게 외치거나 우는 것이고, '~의 소리를 듣다'는 곧 '순종하다'를 뜻하는 관용구입니다. 문맥에 따라 '외침, 울음, 소문'으로도 옮깁니다.

H7136a.d: [קָרָה] vb. encounter, meet, befall; Qal; encounter, meet; befall; Niph; encounter, meet without pre-arrangement; chance to be present; Hiph; of י׳, cause (the right thing, good fortune) to occur; of Israel, ye shall (cause cities to occur rightly for yourselves, i.e.) select cities as suitable
H7136a.sd: to light upon (chiefly by accident); causatively, to bring about; specifically, to impose timbers (for roof or floor) — appoint, lay (make) beams, befall, bring, come (to pass unto), floor, (hap) was, happen (unto), meet, send good speed

H1870.d: דֶּ֫רֶךְ 715 n.m. way, road, distance, journey, manner; way, road, path; journey; of direction, almost or quite = toward; way, manner; fig. of course of life, or action, undertakings; of moral action and character; of duty; specif.: in good sense; oftener in bad sense; way of י׳
H1870.sd: a road (as trodden); figuratively, a course of life or mode of action, often adverb — along, away, because of, by, conversation, custom, (east-) ward, journey, manner, passenger, through, toward, (high-) (path-) way(-side), whither(-soever)
H1870.kd: דֶּ֫רֶךְ — 남성명사, 약 715회. '길'. 첫째, 사람이 밟고 다니는 길·도로·오솔길. 둘째, 여정, 여행, 그 거리. 셋째, 방향을 나타내어 거의 '~쪽으로'가 됩니다. 넷째, 방식, 태도. 다섯째, 비유적으로 살아가는 길, 하는 일, 행실. 여섯째, 특히 도덕적 행위와 인격을 가리켜 좋은 뜻으로도 나쁜 뜻으로도 쓰이며, 마땅히 지켜야 할 도리를 뜻하기도 합니다. '여호와의 길'이라는 표현이 두드러집니다.

H2076.d: זָבַח 134 vb. slaughter for sacrifice; Qal 112; slaughter for sacrifice; slaughter for eating; slaughter for divine judgment; Pi. 22 sacrifice
H2076.sd: to slaughter an animal (usually in sacrifice) — kill, offer, (do) sacrifice, slay

H2389.d: חָזָק adj. strong, stout, mighty; strong; as subst., a strong one
H2389.sd: strong (usu. in a bad sense, hard, bold, violent) — harder, hottest, impudent, loud, mighty, sore, stiff(-hearted), strong(-er)

H6381.d: [פָּלָא] 71 vb. denom. Niph. etc., be surpassing, extraordinary; Niph; be beyond one's power, difficult to do; be difficult to understand; be extraordinary, wonderful; as subst., marvellous things; = wonderful acts of י׳ in judgement and redemption; Pi. make a special votive offering; Hiph; do a hard or difficult thing; make wonderful, do wondrously; of God working wonders in doing; Hithp. thou dost shew thyself marvellous (act inexplicably) against me
H6381.sd: properly, perhaps to separate, i.e. distinguish (literally or figuratively); by implication, to be (causatively, make) great, difficult, wonderful — accomplish, (arise...too, be too) hard, hidden, things too high, (be, do, do a, shew) marvelous(-ly, -els, things, work), miracles, perform, separate, make singular, (be, great, make) wonderful(-ers, -ly, things, works), wondrous (things, works, -ly)

H7130.sd: properly, the nearest part, i.e. the center, whether literal, figurative or adverbial (especially with preposition) — × among, × before, bowels, × unto charge, eat (up), × heart, × him, × in, inward (× -ly, part, -s, thought), midst, out of, purtenance, × therein, × through, × within self

H2580.d: חֵן n.m. favour, grace; favour, grace, elegance; favour, acceptance
H2580.sd: graciousness, i.e. subjective (kindness, favor) or objective (beauty) — favour, grace(-ious), pleasant, precious, (well-) favoured

H5869a.d: עַ֫יִן 859 n.f. eye; lit. as physical organ; eyes as showing mental qualities; desire of the eyes, abominations of the eyes; Fig. of mental and physical faculties, acts and states; Transferred mngs.: visible surface of earth; appearance; gleam, sparkle; Other phrases are: an eye for an eye; eye to eye; in the presence of, in full view of; of business transaction; on the forehead
H5869a.sd: an eye (literally or figuratively); by analogy, a fountain (as the eye of the landscape) — affliction, outward appearance, before, think best, colour, conceit, be content, countenance, displease, eye((-brow), (-d), -sight), face, favour, fountain, furrow (from the margin), × him, humble, knowledge, look, ( well), × me, open(-ly), (not) please, presence, regard, resemblance, sight, × thee, × them, think, × us, well, × you(-rselves)
H5869a.kd: עַ֫יִן — 여성명사, 약 859회. '눈'. 첫째, 신체 기관으로서의 눈. 둘째, 마음의 상태가 드러나는 자리로서의 눈(예: 눈의 욕심, 눈이 가증히 여기는 것). 셋째, 비유적으로 정신적·육체적 능력과 행위와 상태를 나타냅니다. 넷째, 뜻이 옮겨 가 땅의 겉면, 겉모양, 반짝이는 빛을 가리킵니다. '눈에는 눈', '눈과 눈이 마주 대하여', '~가 보는 앞에서'와 같은 관용구가 많습니다. 스트롱은 같은 형태가 '샘'을 뜻하기도 한다고 밝히는데, 땅의 눈이라는 비유입니다. 문맥에 따라 호의·보기에·생각에로 옮기는 일이 잦습니다.

H7387.d: רֵיקָם adv. emptily, vainly; in empty condition, empty = with empty hands; in vain, without effect
H7387.sd: emptily; figuratively (objective) ineffectually, (subjective) undeservedly — without cause, empty, in vain, void

H7592.d: שָׁאַל 170 vb. ask, inquire; Qal; ask, ask for; specif. ask as a fovour, for temporary use, i.e. borrow; in weakened sense, seek, desire (late); inquire of; inquire of, consult, deity, oracle, etc; in weakened sense, seek, desire (late); Niph. ask for oneself; Pi; inquire carefully; beg, practise beggary; Hiph. (prop. let one ask [successfully], give, or lend, on request, then) grant, make over to (as a favour, with or without request)
H7592.sd: to inquire; by implication, to request; by extension, to demand — ask (counsel, on), beg, borrow, lay to charge, consult, demand, desire, × earnestly, enquire, greet, obtain leave, lend, pray, request, require, salute, × straitly, × surely, wish

H7934.sd: a resident; by extension, a fellow-citizen — inhabitant, neighbour, nigh

H1481a.d: גּוּר vb. sojourn; Qal; sojourn; abide; Hithpol. seek hospitality with
H1481a.sd: properly, to turn aside from the road (for a lodging or any other purpose), i.e. sojourn (as a guest); also to shrink, fear (as in a strange place); also to gather for hostility (as afraid) — abide, assemble, be afraid, dwell, fear, gather (together), inhabitant, remain, sojourn, stand in awe, (be) stranger, × surely

H3627.sd: something prepared, i.e. any apparatus (as an implement, utensil, dress, vessel or weapon) — armour(-bearer), artillery, bag, carriage, furnish, furniture, instrument, jewel, that is made of, × one from another, that which pertaineth, pot, psaltery, sack, stuff, thing, tool, vessel, ware, weapon, whatsoever
H3627.kd: כְּלִי — 남성명사, 약 324회. '그릇, 기물, 연장'. 본디 '갖추어 만든 것'이라는 뜻이라, 그릇뿐 아니라 연장·기구·악기·무기·옷·세간을 두루 가리킵니다. 그래서 문맥에 따라 '병기, 기구, 악기, 세간, 짐'으로 갈라 옮겨야 합니다. '병기 든 자'라는 표현도 이 말로 이루어집니다.

H3701.d: כֶּ֫סֶף 402 n.m. silver, money; = silver ore, raw silver; silver as bright, shining; silver, as wealth; silver as spoil of war; silver as merchandise; silver as costly gift; silver as material; silver as measure of weight and value; among vbs. and phr
H3701.sd: silver (from its pale color); by implication, money — money, price, silver(-ling)
H3701.kd: כֶּ֫סֶף — 남성명사, 약 402회. '은, 돈'. 첫째, 은광석 곧 제련하지 않은 은. 둘째, 빛나는 금속으로서의 은. 셋째, 재물로서의 은. 넷째, 전리품. 다섯째, 사고파는 물품. 여섯째, 값진 예물. 일곱째, 기물을 만드는 재료. 여덟째, 무게와 값을 재는 단위. 화폐가 따로 없던 시대라 은의 무게로 값을 치렀기 때문에, 문맥에 따라 '돈, 값, 은전'으로 옮깁니다. 스트롱은 창백한 빛깔에서 온 이름으로 봅니다.

H2091.d: זָהָב 385 n.m. gold; = gold-ore, gold in raw state; gold as wealth; gold as spoil of war; gold as merchandise; gold as costly gift; gold as material; gold described by its source; gold defined by var. adj. and pts; as measure of weight and value; = golden oil, from colour; often named with; the chief vbs. used
H2091.sd: gold, figuratively, something gold-colored (i.e. yellow), as oil, a clear sky — gold(-en), fair weather
H2091.kd: זָהָב — 남성명사, 약 385회. '금'. 첫째, 금광석 곧 제련하지 않은 금. 둘째, 재물로서의 금. 셋째, 전리품. 넷째, 사고파는 물품. 다섯째, 값진 예물. 여섯째, 기물을 만드는 재료. 일곱째, 산지로 이름 붙인 금('오빌의 금'). 여덟째, 여러 형용사로 가려 부른 금('정금'). 아홉째, 무게와 값의 단위. 열째, 빛깔이 같아 '맑은 기름'을 가리키기도 합니다. 스트롱은 누런 빛깔을 띠는 것, 이를테면 맑게 갠 하늘에도 비유적으로 쓰인다고 밝힙니다.

H8071.d: שִׂמְלָה n.f. wrapper, mantle;—usu. square piece of cloth worn as outer garment; as covering in sleep; more gen. garment, clothes (pl.)
H8071.sd: a dress, especially a mantle — apparel, cloth(-es, -ing), garment, raiment. Compare 8008

H6030b.d: עָנָה 316 vb. answer, respond; Qal; answer, respond to sthg. said, actual or implied; respond to an occasion, speak in view of circumstances; money meets all demands; specif. respond as a witness, testify; less oft. make response as one accused (respondent); Niph; make answer; be answered; Hiph. wholly dub.; causes all things to respond in the joy of his heart
H6030b.sd: properly, to eye or (generally) to heed, i.e. pay attention; by implication, to respond; by extension to begin to speak; specifically to sing, shout, testify, announce — give account, afflict (by mistake for 6031), (cause to, give) answer, bring low (by mistake for 6031), cry, hear, Leannoth, lift up, say, × scholar, (give a) shout, sing (together by course), speak, testify, utter, (bear) witness. See also 1042, 1043

H2005.d: הֵן 100 demonstr.adv. or interj. lo!, behold (on etym. v. הִנֵּה), less widely used than הִנֵּה, and in prose mostly confined to calling attention to some fact upon which action is to be taken, or a conclusion based
H2005.sd: lo!; also (as expressing surprise) if — behold, if, lo, though

H0539.d: [אָמַן] vb. confirm, support; Qal; as vb. support, nourish; as subst. foster-father; foster-mother, nurse; pillars, supporters of the door; Niph; carried by nurse; made firm, sure, lasting; confirmed, established, sure; verified, confirmed; reliable, faithful, trusty; Hiph; stand firm; trust, believe
H0539.sd: properly, to build up or support; to foster as a parent or nurse; figuratively to render (or be) firm or faithful, to trust or believe, to be permanent or quiet; morally to be true or certain — hence, assurance, believe, bring up, establish, fail, be faithful (of long continuance, stedfast, sure, surely, trusty, verified), nurse, (-ing father), (put), trust, turn to the right

H4294.d: מַטֶּה 251 n.m; staff, rod, shaft; branch; tribe
H4294.sd: a branch (as extending); figuratively, a tribe; also a rod, whether for chastising (figuratively, correction), ruling (a sceptre), throwing (a lance), or walking (a staff; figuratively, a support of life, e.g. bread) — rod, staff, tribe

H5175.d: נָחָשׁ n.m. serpent; serpent; bronze image of serpent; mythol. fleeing serpent

H5127.d: נוּס 160 vb. flee, escape; Qal; flee; escape; take flight, depart, disappear; fly (to the attack) on horseback; Po‛lel the breath of י׳ driveth at it, driveth it on; Hithpo‛l. in order to take flight before the bow; Hiph; put to flight; drive hastily to a safe place; cause to disappear, hide
H5127.sd: to flit, i.e. vanish away (subside, escape; causatively, chase, impel, deliver) — × abate, away, be displayed, (make to) flee (away, -ing), put to flight, × hide, lift up a standard

H0270.d: אָחַז 68 vb. grasp, take hold of, take possession; Qal grasp, take hold of; Niph. be caught; Pi. enclose, overlay; Hoph. fastened
H0270.sd: to seize (often with the accessory idea of holding in possession) — be affrighted, bar, (catch, lay, take) hold (back), come upon, fasten, handle, portion, (get, have or take) possess(-ion)

H2180.d: זָנָב n.m. tail, also (fig.), end, stump

H2388.d: חָזַק 291 vb. be or grow firm, strong, strengthen; Qal; intrans. be or grow strong; transit. only strengthened him not; Pi; make strong (physically); strengthen the hands (acc.) of anyone, sustain, encourage; make strong = bold, encourage; make firm; make rigid, hard, i.e. perverse, obstinate, harden; Hiph; make strong, strengthen; make firm, the kingdom; display strength; make severe, of battle; support; = repair; prevail; esp. take or keep hold of, seize, grasp; Hithp; strengthen oneself; put forth strength, use one's strength; withstand; hold strongly with
H2388.sd: to fasten upon; hence, to seize, be strong (figuratively, courageous, causatively strengthen, cure, help, repair, fortify), obstinate; to bind, restrain, conquer — aid, amend, × calker, catch, cleave, confirm, be constant, constrain, continue, be of good (take) courage(-ous, -ly), encourage (self), be established, fasten, force, fortify, make hard, harden, help, (lay) hold (fast), lean, maintain, play the man, mend, become (wax) mighty, prevail, be recovered, repair, retain, seize, be (wax) sore, strengthen (self), be stout, be (make, shew, wax) strong(-er), be sure, take (hold), be urgent, behave self valiantly, withstand

H3709.d: כַּף 192 n.f. hollow, or flat of the hand, palm, sole of foot, hand
H3709.sd: the hollow hand or palm (so of the paw of an animal, of the sole, and even of the bowl of a dish or sling, the handle of a bolt, the leaves of a palm-tree); figuratively, power — branch, foot, hand((-ful), -dle, (-led)), hollow, middle, palm, paw, power, sole, spoon

H2436.d: חֵיק, חֵק n.[m.] bosom; of fold of garment, at breast; carry in bosom; bosom as part of body
H2436.sd: the bosom (literally or figuratively) — bosom, bottom, lap, midst, within

H6879.d: [צָרַע] vb. denom., only in pass., be stricken with leprosy, leprous; Qal elsewh. as subst., = leper; Pu. leprous
H6879.sd: to scourge, i.e. (intransitive and figurative) to be stricken with leprosy — leper, leprous

H7725.d: שׁוּב 1056 vb. turn back, return; Qal 683;—turn back, return: turn back; return, come or go back; esp. return unto; of dying; of revival from death; fig. of human relations: return to leader, king; = change so as to appoach (in purpose, desire); turn, i.e. resort to; return to a physical condition; abs. = change course of action; fig., specif. of spiritual relations: turn back from God = apostatize; of י׳, turn away; turn back to God (= seek penitently); abs. repent; turn back from evil; of י׳; of י׳, return (to shew favour); of inanimate things (sts. personified, or treated as things of life): denoting repetition, etc; trans; Pō‛l; bring back; fig. restore, refresh; restore, repair; lead away (enticingly); shew turning = apostatize; Hiph. 353 cause to return, bring back; bring back into bondage; put back; = draw back; = give back, restore; = relinguish; = give in payment, requital; bring one back (from dead); bring back heart; = refresh; bring back words of people; bring back (in retribution) upon; pay as recompense; turn back, backward = repel, defeat; turn away face; late, turn toward, acc. face; turn against; bring back to mind, take into consideration; = shew a turning away from your idols (i.e. turn away); reverse, revoke = repel, defeat; Hoph. my money has been returned
H7725.sd: to turn back (hence, away) transitively or intransitively, literally or figuratively (not necessarily with the idea of return to the starting point); generally to retreat; often adverbial, again — ((break, build, circumcise, dig, do anything, do evil, feed, lay down, lie down, lodge, make, rejoice, send, take, weep)) × again, (cause to) answer ( again), × in any case (wise), × at all, averse, bring (again, back, home again), call (to mind), carry again (back), cease, × certainly, come again (back), × consider, continually, convert, deliver (again), deny, draw back, fetch home again, × fro, get (oneself) (back) again, × give (again), go again (back, home), (go) out, hinder, let, (see) more, × needs, be past, × pay, pervert, pull in again, put (again, up again), recall, recompense, recover, refresh, relieve, render (again), requite, rescue, restore, retrieve, (cause to, make to) return, reverse, reward, say nay, send back, set again, slide back, still, × surely, take back (off), (cause to, make to) turn (again, self again, away, back, back again, backward, from, off), withdraw
H7725.kd: שׁוּב — 동사, 약 1,056회. '돌이키다, 돌아오다'. 칼형이 683회로, 돌아서다·되돌아오다·~에게로 돌아가다가 기본입니다. 죽음을 두고 '흙으로 돌아가다', 되살아남을 두고 '살아 돌아오다'로도 씁니다. 사람 사이에서는 지도자에게 돌아가다, 마음이나 뜻을 바꾸어 다가가다, 어떤 상태로 되돌아가다, 하던 일을 그만두다가 됩니다. 영적으로는 특히 중요해서, 하나님에게서 돌아서면 '배교하다', 하나님께로 돌아서면 '회개하다'이며, 악에서 돌이키는 것도 이 말입니다. 하나님이 주어이면 얼굴을 돌리시거나 다시 은혜를 베푸시러 돌아오시는 것을 뜻합니다. 히필형은 353회로 '돌려보내다, 되돌리다, 돌려주다, 갚다, 물리치다, 취소하다' 등 매우 넓게 쓰입니다. 부사처럼 쓰여 '다시'를 나타내기도 합니다.

H1320.d: בָּשָׂר 266 n.m. flesh; of the body; flesh for the body itself; male organ of generation (euphemism); flesh for kindred, blood-relations; man over against God as frail or erring
H1320.sd: flesh (from its freshness); by extension, body, person; also (by euphemistically) the pudenda of a man — body, (fat, lean) flesh(-ed), kin, (man-) kind, nakedness, self, skin

H7223.sd: first, in place, time or rank (as adjective or noun) — ancestor, (that were) before(-time), beginning, eldest, first, fore(-father) (-most), former (thing), of old time, past

H0314.d: אַחֲרוֹן 61 f. אַחֲרוֹנָה, pl. אַחֲרֹנִים (also אַחֲרוֹנִים), adj. from אַחַר, coming after or behind; of place, behind, hindermost; of time, latter or last
H0314.sd: hinder; generally, late or last; specifically (as facing the east) western — after (-ward), to come, following, hind(-er, -ermost, -most), last, latter, rereward, ut(ter) most

H8210.d: שָׁפַךְ 113 vb. pour out, pour; Qal; lit; fig; Niph. be poured out; Pu. be poured out; Hithp. my soul pours itself out upon me
H8210.sd: to spill forth (blood, a libation, liquid metal; or even a solid, i.e. to mound up); also (figuratively) to expend (life, soul, complaint, money, etc.); intensively, to sprawl out — cast (up), gush out, pour (out), shed(-der, out), slip

H3004.d: יַבָּשָׁה n.f. dry land, dry ground

H1818.d: דָּם 300 n.m. blood; blood of man or animal; usually blood become visible; blood used with religious significance; fig. of wine
H1818.sd: blood (as that which when shed causes death) of man or an animal; by analogy, the juice of the grape; figuratively (especially in the plural) bloodshed (i.e. drops of blood) — blood(-y, -guiltiness, (-thirsty), innocent
H1818.kd: דָּם — 남성명사, 약 300회. '피'. 사람이나 짐승의 피를 가리키며, 대개 밖으로 흘러 눈에 보이게 된 피를 뜻합니다. 제사와 관련해 종교적인 뜻을 담아 쓰이는 자리가 특히 많습니다. 비유적으로 포도주를 '포도의 피'라 부르기도 합니다. 복수형은 흔히 '흘린 피' 곧 살인의 죄를 가리켜 '피 흘린 죄'가 됩니다.

H3006.d: יַבֶּ֫שֶׁת n.f. id. [j.aj.ad], made by God’s hand; water shall become blood

H0994.d: בִּי part. of entreaty, craving permission to address a superior, I pray, excuse me
H0994.sd: oh that!; with leave, or if it please — alas, O, oh

H0136.d: אָדוֹן n.m. lord (אֲדֹנִי, אֲדֹנַי, אֲדֹנָי are variations of Mass. pointing to distinguish divine reference fr. human. Pl., with few exc. an intens. pl. of rank; word takes sf. as pl. in all other pers.; so doubtless here. Orig. reading prob. in all cases אֲדֹנַי; אֲדֹנִי now found in J 51 t.)
H0136.sd: the Lord (used as a proper name of God only) — (my) Lord
H0136.kd: אֲדֹנָי — '주(主)'. 본디 '주인'을 뜻하는 אָדוֹן의 복수형에 일인칭 어미가 붙은 형태인데, 마소라 학자들은 하나님을 가리킬 때와 사람을 가리킬 때를 모음으로 구별해 적었습니다. 사람에게 쓰면 אֲדֹנִי('내 주여'), 하나님께 쓰면 אֲדֹנָי가 됩니다. 여기서 복수형은 수가 여럿이라는 뜻이 아니라 지위의 높음을 나타내는 존엄의 복수입니다. 여호와(H3068)를 소리 내어 읽지 않고 이 말로 대신 읽는 관습이 여기서 비롯되었습니다.

H8543.d: תְּמוֹל (תְּמֹל) 23, אֶתְמוֹל 5, אִתְמוֹל, אֶתְמוּל subst., used sts. as adv.acc., yesterday, fig. recently, formerly
H8543.sd: properly, ago, i.e. a (short or long) time since; especially yesterday, or day before yesterday — before (-time), these (three) days, heretofore, time past, yesterday

H8032.d: שִׁלְשֹׁם and (less oft.) שִׁלְשׁוֹם 25 adv. = three days ago, specif. day before yesterday
H8032.sd: trebly, i.e. (in time) day before yesterday — before (that time, -time), excellent things (from the margin), heretofore, three days, time past

H0227b.sd: at that time or place; also as a conjunction, therefore — beginning, for, from, hitherto, now, of old, once, since, then, at which time, yet

H5650.d: עֶ֫בֶד 799 n.m. slave, servant; slave, servant of household; Subjects, of chief; Servants, worshippers of God; Servant of י׳, in a special sense; Israel as a people is servant of י׳; In polite address of equals or superiors the Hebrews used עַבְדְּךָ thy servant = 1 pers. sing., I; Phrases
H5650.sd: a servant — × bondage, bondman, (bond-) servant, (man-) servant
H5650.kd: עֶ֫בֶד — 남성명사, 약 799회. '종, 노예'. 첫째, 집안의 종이나 노예. 둘째, 왕이나 우두머리에게 딸린 신하. 셋째, 하나님을 섬기는 예배자. 넷째, 특별한 뜻으로 '여호와의 종'이라 불리는 이들(모세·다윗·선지자, 그리고 이사야의 종의 노래). 다섯째, 백성으로서의 이스라엘 전체가 여호와의 종으로 불립니다. 여섯째, 히브리 사람들은 대등하거나 윗사람에게 공손히 말할 때 '당신의 종'이라는 표현으로 '나'를 대신했습니다.

H3515.sd: heavy; figuratively in a good sense (numerous) or in a bad sense (severe, difficult, stupid) — (so) great, grievous, hard(-ened), (too) heavy(-ier), laden, much, slow, sore, thick

H6310.d: פֶּה 485 n.m. mouth; mouth, of man, organ of eating and drinking; external organ; much oftener, as organ of speech, of man; as laughing; panting; of God; of idols; of musical instr. = sound; of animals; hence of edge of sword; mouth = opening, orifice; extremity, end; = portion; with preps
H6310.sd: the mouth (as the means of blowing), whether literal or figurative (particularly speech); specifically edge, portion or side; adverbially (with preposition) according to — accord(-ing as, -ing to), after, appointment, assent, collar, command(-ment), × eat, edge, end, entry, file, hole, × in, mind, mouth, part, portion, × (should) say(-ing), sentence, skirt, sound, speech, × spoken, talk, tenor, × to, two-edged, wish, word
H6310.kd: פֶּה — 남성명사, 약 485회. '입'. 첫째, 먹고 마시는 기관으로서의 입. 둘째, 훨씬 더 자주는 말하는 기관으로서의 입. 웃거나 헐떡이는 데도 씁니다. 셋째, 하나님의 입, 우상의 입. 넷째, 악기의 '소리'. 다섯째, 짐승의 입, 여기서 칼의 '날'이라는 뜻이 나와 '두 날 가진 칼'이라는 표현을 이룹니다. 여섯째, 열린 곳 곧 구멍, 어귀. 일곱째, 끝. 여덟째, '몫'. 전치사와 함께 쓰이면 '~의 명령대로, ~에 따라'가 됩니다. '여호와의 입'은 곧 그분의 말씀이자 명령입니다.

H3956.d: לָשׁוֹן n.m. and (more oft.) f. tongue; tongue of men; = language; tongue of animals; tongue of fire; = (tongue-shaped) wedge of gold; = (tongue-shaped) bay of sea
H3956.sd: the tongue (of man or animals), used literally (as the instrument of licking, eating, or speech), and figuratively (speech, an ingot, a fork of flame, a cove of water) — babbler, bay, evil speaker, language, talker, tongue, wedge

H0120.d: אָדָם 560 n.m. man, mankind; a man = human being; coll. man, mankind; n.pr.m. Adam, first man (without art.); n.pr.loc. city in Jordan valley (as built?)
H0120.sd: ruddy i.e. a human being (an individual or the species, mankind, etc.) — × another, hypocrite, common sort, × low, man (mean, of low degree), person
H0120.kd: אָדָם — 남성명사, 약 560회. '사람'. 첫째, 한 사람 곧 인간. 둘째, 집합적으로 사람 전체 곧 인류. 셋째, 관사 없이 쓰여 첫 사람의 이름 '아담'. 넷째, 요단 골짜기에 있던 성읍 이름. 스트롱은 '붉다'는 말과 이어 흙빛을 띤 존재로 풉니다. 남녀를 아우르는 말이며, 남자를 가리키는 אִישׁ와는 결이 다릅니다.

H0176a.d: אוֹ 320 conj. or; sometimes implying a preference, nearly or rather; introducing a sentence, esp. a particular case under a general principle, or = or if; if perchance; once, with the juss. = except
H0176a.sd: desire (and so probably in Proverbs 31:4); hence (by way of alternative) or, also if — also, and, either, if, at the least, × nor, or, otherwise, then, whether

H0483.d: אִלֵּם adj. dumb, unable to speak

H3384b.d: יָרָה vb. throw, shoot; Qal; throw, cast; cast (= lay, set), corner-stone; pillar; shoot arrows; throw water, rain; Niph. shot through (with arrows); Hiph; throw, cast; shoot (arrows); throw water, rain; point out, shew; direct, teach, instruct
H3384b.sd: properly, to flow as water (i.e. to rain); transitively, to lay or throw (especially an arrow, i.e. to shoot); figuratively, to point out (as if by aiming the finger), to teach — ( ) archer, cast, direct, inform, instruct, lay, shew, shoot, teach(-er,-ing), through

H2015.d: הָפַךְ vb. turn, overturn; Qal; trans; turn, turn about, turn over; overturn, overthrow; turn = change, transform; intrans; turn, turn back; turn = change, change into; Niph; reflex. & intrans; turn oneself, turn, turn back; turn = change (oneself); be perverse; pass; be turned, turn over to; be reversed; be turned, changed; be overturned, overthrown; be upturned, of subterran. work of miners; Hithp; turn this way & that, every way; transform oneself; Hoph. there have been turned upon me terrors

H5704.d: עַד, in poetry עֲדֵי prep. as far as, even to, up to, until, while; prep; of space; Of time; Of degree; conj; until; While; Of degree, to the point that, so that even (rare); עַד לְ, a strengthened form for עַד. Thus; of space; Of time; Of degree
H5704.sd: as far (or long, or much) as, whether of space (even unto) or time (during, while, until) or degree (equally with) — against, and, as, at, before, by (that), even (to), for(-asmuch as), (hither-) to, how long, into, as long (much) as, (so) that, till, toward, until, when, while, ( as) yet
H5704.kd: עַד (시문에서는 עֲדֵי) — 전치사이자 접속사. '~까지'. 전치사로 (1) 공간에서 '~에 이르기까지', (2) 시간에서 '~때까지', (3) 정도에서 '~에 이르도록'. 접속사로 (1) '~할 때까지', (2) '~하는 동안', (3) 드물게 정도를 나타내어 '~할 지경까지, ~하기까지'. עַד לְ는 이를 강조한 형태로 같은 세 갈래로 쓰입니다. מִן과 짝을 이루어 '~에서부터 ~까지'라는 범위를 나타냅니다.

H2063.d: זֶה demonstr.pron. and adv.; fem. זֹאת, once זֹאתָה; this, here; standing alone; In appos. to subst; More oft. as pred; It is attached enclitically, almost as an adv., to certain words, esp. interrog. pronouns, to impart, in a manner often not reproducible in Engl. idiom, directness and force, bringing the question or statement made into close relation with the speaker; In poetry, as a relative pron. (rare); With prefixes (in special senses)
H2063.sd: this (often used adverb) — hereby (-in, -with), it, likewise, the one (other, same), she, so (much), such (deed), that, therefore, these, this (thing), thus
H2063.kd: זֹאת — זֶה의 여성형 지시대명사이자 지시부사, 약 604회. '이, 이것, 여기'. 홀로 서서 '이것'을 가리키거나, 명사에 동격으로 붙거나, 서술어 자리에서 '이것은 ~이다'가 됩니다. 의문사 뒤에 붙어 표현에 직접성과 힘을 더하기도 하고, 시문에서는 드물게 관계대명사로 쓰입니다. 전치사가 붙으면 '이로써, 이 때문에, 그러므로'가 됩니다.

H3811.d: [לָאָה] vb. be weary, impatient; Qal be weary; Niph. be weary of doing a thing, make oneself weary in doing something, weary (i.e. strenuously exert) oneself; Hiph. weary, make weary, exhaust
H3811.sd: to tire; (figuratively) to be (or make) disgusted — faint, grieve, lothe, (be, make) weary (selves)

H8354.d: שָׁתָה 217 vb. drink; Qal 216; Niph. all which is (may be) drunk
H8354.sd: to imbibe (literally or figuratively) — × assuredly, banquet, × certainly, drink(-er, -ing), drunk (× -ard), surely. (Prop. intensive of 8248.)

H4723c.sd: something waited for, i.e. confidence (objective or subjective); also a collection, i.e. (of water) a pond, or (of men and horses) a caravan or drove — abiding, gathering together, hope, linen yarn, plenty (of water), pool

H6086.sd: a tree (from its firmness); hence, wood (plural sticks) — carpenter, gallows, helve, pine, plank, staff, stalk, stick, stock, timber, tree, wood

H0068.sd: a stone — carbuncle, mason, plummet, (chalk-, hail-, head-, sling-) stone(-ny), (divers) weight(-s)

H7311a.d: רוּם vb. be high, exalted, rise; Qal; be high, lit. rock (in fig.); esp. of י׳; be raised, uplifted; be lifted, rise, of ark; Pō‛lēl; raise, rear, children; cause tree to grow; lift up; exalt, extol, acc. י׳; Pō‛lal be lift up; Hiph; raise, rear, c. acc., hand; raise poor; lift up voice; (take into one's hand and) lift, take up, stone; set up, erect, stone; set on high, throne; lift up, exalt, c. acc. pers; lift up and take away, remove; lift off and present, contribute, offer; Hoph. be taken off from; be abolished; Hithpō‛l. and he shall exalt and magnify himself above, etc.; I will raise myself

H1288.kd: בָּרַךְ — 동사, 약 329회. 본디 '무릎을 꿇다'입니다. 칼형은 '꿇어앉다' 그리고 '복을 주다'. 니팔형은 '복을 받다'. 피엘형이 대부분으로, (1) 무릎 꿇어 하나님을 송축하다, (2) 하나님이 사람에게 복을 주시다, (3) 사람이 사람에게 복을 빌다, (4) 복을 빌며 인사하다. 그런데 (5) 헤어질 때 하는 인사에서 뜻이 뒤집혀 '저주하다'로도 쓰이는데, 이는 복을 빈다는 말을 완곡하게 돌려 쓴 것으로 봅니다(욥기와 열왕기의 몇 자리). 푸알형은 '복을 받다, 송축을 받다'. 히필형은 '낙타를 꿇게 하다'. 히트파엘형은 '스스로 복되다 하다'. 무릎을 꿇는 자세와 복을 주고받는 일이 한 낱말로 이어져 있는 점이 이 말의 특징입니다.

H5920.d: עַל, עָ֑ל; subst. height; As prep. upon, and hence on the ground of, according to, on account of, on behalf of, concerning, beside, in addition to, together with, beyond, above, over, by, on to, towards, to, against; Upon, of the substratum upon which an object in any way rests, or on which an action is performed; —; of clothing, etc., which any one wears; With verbs of covering or protecting, even though the cover or veil be not over or above the thing covered, but around or before it; Of what rests heavily upon a person, or is a burden to him; Of a duty, payment, care, etc., imposed upon a person, or devolving on him; על is used idiom. to give pathos to the expression of an emotion, by emphasizing the person who is its subject, and who, as it were, feels it acting upon him; חָיָה עַל to live upon (as upon a foundation or support); Of the ground or basis, on which a thing is done; It expresses excess; It denotes elevation or pre-eminence; It expresses addition; It expresses the idea of being extended, or suspended over anything, without however being in contact with it, above, over; From the sense of inclining or impending over, על comes to denote contiguity or proximity, Engl. by (or sts. on); In connection with verbs of motion (actual or fig.); By writers of the silver age, על is sts. used with the force of a dative; With other particles: As conj; עַל אֲשֶׁר because that; עַל כִּי similar in meaning, but less frequent; עַל alone: because; notwithstanding that, although; Compounds: with כְּ (rare and late); as concerning, as upon; the like of their deeds is the like of (that which) he will repay; מֵעַל from upon, from over, from by
